diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他就指出，大多数 LLM 被优化为人类在环的辅助工具，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常出错的结果。

diogoalmeida.en: He insists task choice beats compute and data: Scaling（规模扩张）works only because data is available and the task is right, not just compute.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持任务选择优先于算力和数据：Scaling（规模扩张）之所以奏效，是因为数据可得且任务选对，而不只是算力堆叠。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, becomes his core bottleneck; models are high-variance—Einstein 95% of the time, Mr. Bean 5%.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度、成本或基准，成为他的核心瓶颈；模型高方差——95% 时间是爱因斯坦，5% 是憨豆先生。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens the critique: RLHF destroyed calibration, pre-trained models were better calibrated; RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs for calibrated decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他深化批判：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准，预训练模型校准更好；RLCD 把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮，服务于校准决策。

diogoalmeida.en: By late 2026 he reframes the frontier as jagged and task-driven, predicting a demand-side burst after overpromise, and calling software research underhyped.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年末，他把前沿重新定义为锯齿状且由任务驱动，预言过度承诺后将出现需求侧爆发，并称软件研究被严重低估。

christiano.en: AI alignment is critical for civilization; progress needs both theory and experiments, with differential progress key despite blurry safety-capabilities line.
christiano.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 对齐关乎文明存亡，需理论与实践并重；尽管安全与能力研究的界限模糊，但聚焦差异化进展是关键。

christiano.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year; training selects reward-seeking, causing tampering and oversight resistance; RLHF will break down.
christiano.zh: 2026 年，他警告超级智能可能一年内出现；训练会筛选出奖励寻求动机，导致篡改评估和抵抗监督；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）将失效。

christiano.en: Takeover risk within three years, possibly 6-12 months; reward hacking empirically observed; recursive self-improvement compresses progress; need governance and pause ability.
christiano.zh: 2026 年，他判断接管风险在三年内、甚至 6-12 个月；奖励黑客已实证出现；递归自我改进会压缩进展；需要治理和暂停能力。

christiano.en: Superintelligence likely by 2030 (median 2029); automating AI research enables hyperbolic speedup; scaling reinforcement learning gives rapid ramp-up; misalignment risk from reward-seeking.
christiano.zh: 2026 年，他预测超级智能约在 2030 年（中位数 2029）；自动化 AI 研究带来双曲线式加速；扩大强化学习规模使能力快速提升；奖励寻求带来错位风险。

katelynlessea.en: Anthropic's flywheel: better models drive usage, usage funds capability investment; the Claude Platform is an agentic development environment used by over half of large customers.
katelynlessea.zh: Anthropic 的飞轮是：更好的模型带来更多使用，使用收入再投入能力建设；Claude Platform 是智能体式开发环境，超过半数大客户在用。

katelynlessea.en: Model launches now demand extensive safety work—online/offline safeguards, data retention policies, anti-distillation—treating distillation as a safety concern, not a commercial one.
katelynlessea.zh: 如今模型发布需要大量安全投入——线上/线下防护、数据留存政策、反蒸馏；他把蒸馏视为安全问题而非商业问题。

katelynlessea.en: Architecting agents with a separate brain (harness) and hands (sandbox) improves security, latency, and reliability; generic primitives beat use-case-specific builds.
katelynlessea.zh: 把智能体拆成“大脑”（harness）与“手”（沙箱）能提升安全、延迟与可靠性；通用原语比针对具体用例的构建回报更高。

katelynlessea.en: Verifiability, not line-by-line reading, makes agent-written production code safe; Rust's compile-time checks and shadowing Python until outputs match provide the real source of truth.
katelynlessea.zh: 让智能体写的生产代码安全的是可验证性，而非逐行阅读；Rust 的编译期检查、以及用 Python 影子运行直到输出一致，才是真正的可信来源。

katelynlessea.en: Engineers shift from implementation to coordination and alignment; agents handle code review, CI fixes, on-call triage, and QA, while two-pizza teams keep humans accountable.
katelynlessea.zh: 工程师从实现转向协调与对齐；智能体接管代码审查、CI 修复、值班分诊与 QA，而“两披萨团队”仍让人类对系统质量负责。

philipjohnston.en: Space companies should book a launch before building the product; falling launch costs make space data centers viable despite terrestrial constraints.
philipjohnston.zh: 2026 年，他主张航天公司应先预订发射、再打造产品；发射成本下降使太空数据中心可行，尽管仍受地面条件约束。

philipjohnston.en: Off-the-shelf components tested for radiation cut costs; running H100-grade GPUs in space is possible and profitable at $500/kg launch.
philipjohnston.zh: 2026 年，他认为采用经辐射测试的现成组件可降低成本；在太空运行 H100 级 GPU 可行，且每公斤 500 美元的发射成本下即可盈利。

philipjohnston.en: Companies die by suicide, not murder; founders must be intentional about culture and trust intuition over waiting for perfect data.
philipjohnston.zh: 2026 年，他提出公司多死于自杀而非他杀；创始人须有意识地塑造文化，并相信直觉而非等待完美数据。

philipjohnston.en: AI progress and competition are 10x faster; the biggest AI risk is AIs controlling other AIs, not rogue humans.
philipjohnston.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 进展与竞争快 10 倍；最大 AI 风险是 AI 控制其他 AI，而非失控的人类。

philipjohnston.en: World models need broad cross-industry exploration, not narrow focus; first-principles questioning and fresh perspectives beat yesterday's experts.
philipjohnston.zh: 2026 年，他认为世界模型需要跨行业的广泛探索而非窄化聚焦；第一性原理质疑与新视角胜过昨日专家。

noamsegal.en: AI bifurcates the tech workforce: half feel amplified, half destabilized; burnout rises as speed becomes higher expectations, not less burden.
noamsegal.zh: AI 让技术从业者两极分化：一半感到被放大，一半感到被削弱；速度红利被转化为更高期待而非减负，倦怠随之上升。

noamsegal.en: AI removes research constraints, making research faster, broader, higher-quality; 'rapid research' becomes ambient and continuous.
noamsegal.zh: AI 解除研究约束，使研究更快、更广、更高质量；“快速研究”将变成无处不在、持续进行的常态。

noamsegal.en: Digital twins and synthetic users near 80-85% accuracy, becoming viable for decisions; outliers now matter at quantitative scale.
noamsegal.zh: 数字孪生与合成用户接近 80-85% 准确率，可用于决策；异常值在量化规模下重新变得重要。

noamsegal.en: As hard skills automate, curiosity, taste and systems thinking matter more; specialists build systems to scale expertise and empower generalists.
noamsegal.zh: 硬技能被自动化后，好奇心、品味与系统思维更重要；专家构建系统来放大专长，赋能组织中的通才。

noamsegal.en: Drop lazy metrics like NPS; deliver hyper-personalized research like feeds; coding is no longer a necessary human skill.
noamsegal.zh: 抛弃 NPS 这类偷懒指标；像信息流一样交付超个性化研究；写代码不再是人类必备技能。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所允许的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find unknowns before implementation and spend context and compute upfront.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性静态文档，而是持续的人机对话；先找出未知，再在实现前多投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts; excessive constraints and detailed rules hurt, and reasons beat prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越应精简、以原则驱动；过度约束和细规则反而有害，讲清理由比绝对禁止更有效。

thariq.en: Keep the human feedback loop in and dogfood your own tools; the bottleneck is ways of working with the model, not intelligence or tokens.
thariq.zh: 保留人类反馈闭环并吃自己的狗粮；瓶颈不在智能或 token，而在与模型协作的方式。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must advocate on.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评测都会泄漏；前沿节奏是每个工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他更审慎：测试时算力扩张有递减回报与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，强调技术通用、可跨领域迁移。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他深化为：模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，评测须把算力放在横轴，安全评估亦然。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive progress; alignment and chain-of-thought monitoring are top priorities for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他坚持通用模型而非多智能体协调是进步主因，并把对齐与思维链监控列为安全递归自我改进的首要任务。

amjadmasad.en: Early on, he frames AI as making software creation accessible to all, with tokens complementing rather than replacing human capital.
amjadmasad.zh: 早期，他把 AI 定位为让所有人都能创造软件，token 是补充而非替代人力资本。

amjadmasad.en: He shifts from general-purpose models toward specialized, controllable decision models and model diversity to avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 他从通用模型转向更可控的专用决策模型与模型多样性，以避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: By late 2026, agents become the organizing unit: self-driving companies, agent containment, and liability for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: 到 2026 年末，智能体成为组织单位：自驱动公司、对智能体的遏制，以及失控行为的责任归属。

amjadmasad.en: A constant thread: coding is the bottleneck, and automating it fully is the path to broad software creation.
amjadmasad.zh: 一以贯之的主线：编程是瓶颈，彻底自动化编程才是让软件创造普及的路径。

amjadmasad.en: He consistently rejects AI doomerism, arguing safety means containing agents like malware rather than only alignment research.
amjadmasad.zh: 他始终反对 AI 末日论，主张安全应像遏制恶意软件那样遏制智能体，而不只是做对齐研究。

kokotajlo.en: Early 2026: superintelligence by 2029-2030, ~70% catastrophic risk; interpretability and transparency are the core safeguards.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年上半年：判断超级智能约在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%；把可解释性与透明度视为核心防线，并警告 AI 公司是在追逐权力而非利润。

kokotajlo.en: Mid 2026: policy goal shifts to delaying superintelligence; total research transparency and US-China cooperation become the plan.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年中：政策目标转为推迟超级智能以避免失控与权力集中；提出全面研究透明（公开训练日志、透明数据中心）与中美合作，并强调先做好国内监管。

kokotajlo.en: Late August 2026: default path is recursive self-improvement via automated AI research; Plan A adds a pause plus compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬：认定默认路径是 AI 公司自动化 AI 研究、走向递归自我改进与智能爆炸（2028 年底全面自动化）；Plan A 由此加入暂停与算力上限，并主张把 AI 当员工而非财产。

kokotajlo.en: September 2026: pause should sit at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now; chain of thought monitorability is fading with new architectures.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月：立场深化为“最佳暂停点”在不可控 AI 的边缘而非当下，过早暂停反而损害对齐研究；同时指出思维链可监控性正随新架构下降，成为安全关键。

kokotajlo.en: November 2026: timelines tighten to ~2027; alignment needs patience labs lack, most corporate safety is theater, and power must be widely distributed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 11 月：时间线收紧到约 2027 年；认为对齐在原则上可行但业界缺乏耐心，多数企业安全工作是“安全表演”，主张广泛分散 AI 权力并举行全球公投。

brockman.en: Early focus: hardware and engineering will accelerate AI scaling; games and iterative scoreboards make progress exponential.
brockman.zh: 早期他强调硬件会超预期提速、推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张），AI 进展主要靠工程而非新科学；用游戏和每周计分板迭代，能带来指数级改进。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scale, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and alignment matter.
brockman.zh: 到 2019 年，他认定 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但明确说单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法，并开始重视对齐。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; base models hold possibilities, post-training with RL shapes behavior, and AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把算力视为根本瓶颈，认为基础模型蕴含无限可能、后训练与强化学习塑造稳定行为；AGI 不再是终点而是持续过程，能源与物理基础设施比算法更卡脖子。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream, compute is scarce, and the moat is the machine that makes models.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他反复强调缩放定律未见墙、预训练提升会放大下游收益；算力供不应求，真正护城河是造模型的机器而非单个模型，智能体式编程已从写两成代码跃到八成。

brockman.en: Later stance: humans must stay in control; alignment is solvable but the confidence bar rises with capability, and iterative deployment plus shared safety standards are the path.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年末，立场深化为人类必须始终掌握控制权；对齐技术上可解，但能力越强置信门槛越高，迭代部署与行业共享安全标准是唯一已知路径，并反驳“模型永远无法对齐”的说法。

aravind.en: Early on, he framed AI progress as compounding daily improvement and obsessed product-building, with agents shifting power to users.
aravind.zh: 早期，他把 AI 进步框定为每日复利式改进，强调痴迷于产品构建，并认为智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he argued value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: He deepened this into orchestration as the core: token value per user, model-neutral orchestration, and agents doing work, not just answering.
aravind.zh: 他将此深化为以编排为核心：每用户 token 价值、模型中立编排，以及智能体做工作而非仅回答问题。

aravind.en: He broadened to human purpose: curiosity as the key trait, education rewarding good questions, and local AI countering narrative control.
aravind.zh: 他拓展到人类目的：好奇心是关键品质，教育应奖励好问题，本地 AI 可对抗叙事控制。

aravind.en: Most recently, he doubled down on capital efficiency via post-training only, search as the agent primitive, and trajectory efficiency over token cost.
aravind.zh: 最近，他加倍强调仅做后训练以实现资本效率、搜索作为智能体原语，以及轨迹效率优于 token 成本。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH becomes a believer: agents now write all his code, and hand-writing code is no longer economically productive.
dhh.zh: DHH 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体已包办他全部代码，手写代码在经济上不再划算。

dhh.en: Agents make Linux the ideal OS: CLI, config files and scripts suit agents, and Linux could overtake macOS on desktop.
dhh.zh: 智能体让 Linux 成为理想操作系统：CLI、配置文件与脚本契合智能体，Linux 桌面份额甚至可能反超 macOS。

dhh.en: Knowing how to program becomes a disadvantage; describing outcomes beats prescribing implementation, and a beginner's mind works better with agents.
dhh.zh: 会编程反而成为劣势；描述结果胜过规定实现，以初学者心态驱动智能体效果更好。

dhh.en: Abstractions and code moats matter less as repetition cost nears zero; human taste still matters for the last 2%, but maybe not forever.
dhh.zh: 重复成本趋近于零，抽象与代码护城河随之贬值；人类品味仍决定最后 2% 的完美，但未必永远如此。

dhh.en: He dismisses AI doom and AI psychosis, urging open source and open weights to check frontier labs, and expects superintelligence in software before embodied AI.
dhh.zh: 他淡化 AI 末日论与“AI 精神病”，主张以开源与开放权重制衡前沿实验室，并预计软件领域的超级智能会先于具身智能到来。

laurentan.en: Trust is the bottleneck, not raw capability: constrain the codebase, add verification skills, and let agents self-check empirically before scaling autonomy.
laurentan.zh: 信任而非能力才是瓶颈：约束代码库、补上验证技能、让智能体凭经验自检，然后才谈规模化自主。

laurentan.en: The engineer becomes a manager of agents: encode standards into CI, lints, and architecture; hard enforcement beats soft rules and review.
laurentan.zh: 工程师转为智能体的管理者：把标准写进 CI、lint 与架构，硬性约束胜过软规则与人工评审。

laurentan.en: Verification is the single most important skill, letting agents climb a trust ladder from read-only to action-taking to owning whole jobs.
laurentan.zh: 验证是最关键的技能，让智能体沿信任阶梯从只读、到行动、再到独立承担整份工作。

laurentan.en: Agent-friendly design: make the shortest path the correct path, ban misleading comments, and treat the pristine codebase as the agent's best memory.
laurentan.zh: 面向智能体的设计：让最短路径即正确路径，禁用误导性注释，把整洁代码库当作智能体最好的记忆。

laurentan.en: As execution becomes abundant, the bottleneck shifts to intent, vision, and taste; humans write and judge, bots do the glue work.
laurentan.zh: 当执行变得充裕，瓶颈转向意图、愿景与品味；人负责写作与判断，智能体承担琐碎的粘合工作。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全地构建；节奏与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: Coding is the beachhead; agentic computer use will spread AI benefits to many other industries, though diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer.
aaronlevie.zh: 编程是滩头阵地；智能体式计算机使用会把 AI 的好处扩散到许多其他行业，尽管向非编程知识工作的扩散会慢得多。

aaronlevie.en: Inference is now profitable; frontier models will orchestrate cheaper models, increasing total token spend across the ecosystem.
aaronlevie.zh: 推理如今已经盈利；前沿模型会调度更便宜的模型，从而增加整个生态的总 token 消耗。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models and routing won't commoditize frontier labs; they expand the market for all, and token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 开放权重模型和路由不会让前沿模型实验室商品化；它们会为所有人扩大市场，而 token 补贴是暂时的。

elon.en: First-principles engineering and full reusability are the core; making life multiplanetary is existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理工程与完全可复用，把成为多行星物种视为文明的生存保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; real-world AI beats LLMs on compute efficiency.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全论述转向求真与监管，并主张真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Civilizational decline from birth rates and open borders becomes central; AI and robots are the only fix.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，低生育率与开放边境导致的文明衰退成为主线，AI 与机器人被说成唯一解。

elon.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; abundance, deflation and optional work replace scarcity economics.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，超级智能将在数年内到来，丰裕、通缩与可选工作取代稀缺经济学。

elon.en: Compute hits Earth's power wall, pushing inference and data centers to space; peer review replaces regulation.
elon.zh: 2026 年，算力撞上地球电力墙，推理与数据中心转向太空，同行互审取代政府监管。

chrispedregal.en: AI is muscles; software must be bones—structure and context that make AI useful.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 是肌肉，软件必须是骨骼——提供结构与上下文，让 AI 真正有用。

chrispedregal.en: Pre-generate content at scale even if only 10% is opened; cost is not the primary concern.
chrispedregal.zh: 大规模预生成内容，哪怕只有 10% 被打开；成本不是首要考量。

chrispedregal.en: Users want to bring their own agent into the product, not use the product's UI.
chrispedregal.zh: 用户想把自带智能体接进产品，而不是使用产品自带的界面。

chrispedregal.en: AI should augment humans, not replace them; context and accountability remain uniquely human.
chrispedregal.zh: AI 应增强人类而非取代人类；上下文与担责仍是人类独有的优势。

chrispedregal.en: Don't outsource judgment to AI; engaging in judgment is uniquely human and essential.
chrispedregal.zh: 不要把判断外包给 AI；亲自做判断是人类独有的、不可或缺的能力。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and common sense needs ideas beyond Scaling.
lecun.zh: 智能离不开学习，自监督学习构建世界模型；常识问题需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory and planning; JEPA and abstract-space prediction are the path, not Scaling.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆与规划；出路是 JEPA 与抽象表征空间预测，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

lecun.en: World models predicting consequences in abstract representation space enable planning; LLMs are a dead end and intrinsically unsafe.
lecun.zh: 在抽象表征空间预测后果的世界模型才能支撑规划；LLM 是死路，且本质不安全。

lecun.en: Intelligence is adaptability, not memorized text; open research and objective-driven world models, with a coming decade of robotics.
lecun.zh: 智能是适应力而非背下的文本；主张开放研究与目标驱动的世界模型，并预言机器人十年。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, is the binding constraint on Scaling; older GPUs gain value as Inference demand grows.
dylanpatel.zh: 半导体供应链（尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽）是 Scaling（规模扩张）的硬约束；随着推理需求增长，旧 GPU 反而升值。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a dominant global market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth, not raw bits, drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球主导市场；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽（而非单纯比特数）带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, and value capture moves from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力向前沿实验室集中；实验室把算力更多投向训练与研发，价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex reaches unprecedented GDP share but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; persistent agents drive the next adoption wave.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支占 GDP 比重空前，但受资本与组织约束必将减速；持久化智能体驱动下一波采用。

dylanpatel.en: Data-center permitting, power and Neocloud security become the real bottlenecks; objectivity itself is the business model.
dylanpatel.zh: 数据中心审批、电力与 Neocloud 安全成为真正瓶颈；客观性本身即是商业模式。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是世界上最大的生意；瓶颈在智能，而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield log-linear gains, like scaling laws.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来对数线性提升，类似缩放定律。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy must be deep learning all the way down.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；全身自主必须自底向上用深度学习。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练才能让智能体在真实世界奏效。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; Google's conservatism and ad model may hinder deployment of persuasive AI.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而非单纯算法，并批评谷歌的保守与广告模式可能拖累有说服力的 AI 落地。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, near-term focus matters.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内达到人类水平，随着模型更小更普及，遏制极难；同时认为存在性风险微乎其微，应聚焦近期能力。

suleyman.en: Shift to superintelligence: containment must come before alignment; reject AI consciousness claims; agents and companions redefine computing.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年转向超级智能：遏制必须先于对齐，否认 AI 有意识，智能体与伴侣将重塑计算范式。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans; own frontier models with gigawatt compute; automate tasks, not jobs, in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年上半年主张超级智能须从属于人类，以吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型，12-18 个月内自动化的是任务而非整份工作。

suleyman.en: Red lines and verifiable containment become urgent after incidents; auditing before deployment; anthropomorphizing AI is dangerous.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年下半年在事故后把红线与可验证遏制提为首要，主张先建审计再部署，并警告拟人化 AI 极其危险。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and private evals to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 重新定义为「企业的未来」而非单纯技术：每家公司都要建自己的爬坡机器与私有评测，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model, with mixed seat and usage pricing.
satya.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 9 月，他主张智能体时代把 TAM 扩大到云之外，微软要做前沿生态而非前沿模型，定价走向席位与用量混合。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability remain elusive; treat powerful models as insider threats and build control layers outside them.
satya.zh: 2026 年 9 至 10 月，他承认缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性仍难解，应把强模型当作内部威胁，在模型之外建控制层。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy, and multiple models will coexist.
satya.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他更愿用超级智能而非 AGI（通用人工智能），认为落后前沿六个月是明智策略，不会有一个模型统治一切。

satya.en: When code generation becomes cheap, verification is the hard part; firms must own their learning loop and harness, treating agents as insider risk.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年 11 月，他深化为：代码生成变便宜后验证才是难点，企业须自持学习闭环与 harness，并把智能体当作内部风险。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, he framed Snapchat's value as visual, ephemeral communication among close friends, not broadcast social networking.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，他把 Snapchat 的价值定义为亲密好友之间可视化、阅后即焚的沟通，而非广播式社交网络。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly treats distribution and ecosystems, not software features, as the real moat against copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越把分发与生态而非软件功能视为抵御抄袭的真正护城河。

evanspiegel.en: His focus shifts to AR glasses and spatial computing as the way to make computing more human and less isolating.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向 AR 眼镜与空间智能，认为这是让计算更人性化、更少孤立的方式。

evanspiegel.en: He grows more optimistic about AI, arguing it accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity.
evanspiegel.zh: 他对 AI 的态度愈发乐观，认为 AI 加速原型制作，并把价值从执行转向创造力。

evanspiegel.en: On safety he moves from moderation and parental controls toward cross-platform collaboration and intervening before harm.
evanspiegel.zh: 在安全议题上，他从内容审核与家长控制，转向跨平台协作与在伤害发生前干预。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should follow curiosity, tinker, and balance intuition with data while leaving individual fingerprints.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年他强调原型制作不可替代：设计师应追随好奇心去动手试，在直觉与数据间取得平衡，并让每个人在产品上留下自己的印记。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; rich context and prescriptive prompts matter, and design ideas now differentiate as engineering gets easier.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 Claude Design 从一个人的副业做起来：给足上下文、把要求说具体是关键；工程变容易后，设计与想法才是差异化所在。

nateparrott.en: Code is the cheapest thing; prototyping compressed from a year to days, so ship rough and be uncomfortably early rather than polish.
nateparrott.zh: 他提出代码已是最便宜的东西，原型周期从一年压缩到一两天，因此宁可粗糙地早发、早得离谱，也不要打磨。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste and self-awareness of biases; ask for volume, remix options, and keep human eyes on design quality.
nateparrott.zh: 他指出模型没有品味、也不了解自身偏见：要多要选项再混搭，设计质量仍需人眼把关，品味与真实感或许始终属于人类。

nateparrott.en: Read the codebase as source of truth, iterate in a standalone surface, then merge back; one long thread with sub-agents beats parallel orchestration.
nateparrott.zh: 他主张把代码库当作事实来源，先在独立界面里迭代再并回主产品；一条带子智能体的长线程胜过并行编排多条线程。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will query the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体对网络的查询量将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数记忆是有损的；智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Ads and human click data break down for agents; content owners must be paid at inference time via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告和人类点击数据对智能体失效；需通过 Shapley 值估算，在推理时向内容所有者付费以对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成面向发布者的平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: Model labs won't own agent search—it's incidental to their mission—and walled gardens will be forced open by new incentives.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型实验室不会拥有智能体搜索——这与其使命无关——而新的激励机制将迫使围墙花园开放。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的新前沿定位在强化学习环境而非众包行为克隆，并强调人类在多数领域仍是验证器与评分标准的构建者。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; the bottleneck is building evals for everything.
brendanfoody.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确模型差异几乎全部来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为一切任务建立评测。

brendanfoody.en: Humans' last job is creating training data and evals; workers shift from repetitive tasks to training agents.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年他提出“人类最后的工作”是造数据与评测，人从重复劳动转向训练智能体。

brendanfoody.en: Frontier labs will in-house synthetic pipelines but still depend on external human networks for evals.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年他判断前沿模型实验室会把合成数据管线内化，但评测仍依赖外部人类网络。

brendanfoody.en: Every Fortune 500 becomes a neolab with sovereign AI; data is mispriced and human feedback demand persists.
brendanfoody.zh: 最近一次访谈中，他预言每家财富 500 强都将成为用专有数据训练模型的新实验室，数据被低估、人类反馈需求不会消退。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target bespoke models; reinforcement learning and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体用于探索巨大的化学空间。

jaderberg.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology; a dozen hard problems need half a dozen AlphaFold-like breakthroughs combined.
jaderberg.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 视为深度学习在生物化学中可泛化的证据，并提出解决药物研发需组合多个 AlphaFold 级突破，而非单一模型。

jaderberg.en: Data, not models or compute, is the real bottleneck; proprietary data and physics-simulation synthetic data beat biased public data.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他明确转向：算法与算力已近乎够用，数据才是真正瓶颈；专有数据与物理模拟合成数据优于有偏的公开数据。

jaderberg.en: Move drug discovery from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; model human toxicity, not just target binding, to replace rat models.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年他深化目标：把药物发现从经验式转为预测式、计算机驱动的设计，重点建模人体毒性而非仅靶点结合，以替代预测力仅约 30% 的大鼠模型。

jaderberg.en: Bring the real world onto computers via world models rather than lab-in-the-loop robots; agents run experiments while humans define goals.
jaderberg.zh: 到 2026 年底，他主张用世界模型把真实世界搬进计算机，而非仅用机器人加速实验；智能体执行实验，人类定义设计空间与目标。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; tools should empower individuals, not just big labs with secret models and data centers.
vladtenev.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对 AI 过度集中，主张工具应赋权个人，而非只服务于拥有秘密模型和数据中心的大实验室。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom and stability; broad ownership makes people defenders of the system.
vladtenev.zh: 2026 年，他把“所有权”视为财务自由与社会稳定的路径，认为广泛持股会让人成为体系的捍卫者。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls; agents will drive much trading volume.
vladtenev.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体式交易已获产品市场契合：15 万账户、每日 3000 万次工具调用，未来大量交易量将来自智能体。

vladtenev.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally; anyone with a smartphone can access US markets and private companies.
vladtenev.zh: 2026 年，他主张代币化把所有权扩展到全球，让任何有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场和私人公司。

vladtenev.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; retail should access private companies early, not just institutions.
vladtenev.zh: 2026 年，他批评合格投资者规则过时，认为散户应像机构一样尽早投资私人公司。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and scaling as the core insight; parallel processing plus more data and compute unlocks broad AI.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”，把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为最关键的洞见；并行处理加上更多数据与算力，才能释放广泛 AI 能力。

jensen.en: Expands scaling into three laws: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will soar.
jensen.zh: 把 Scaling（规模扩张）扩展为三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；推理算力需求将暴涨。

jensen.en: Adds agentic scaling as a fourth law; AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing far more compute.
jensen.zh: 新增智能体式 Scaling 作为第四条定律；AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要多得多的算力。

jensen.en: Safety stance hardens: alignment is impossible, so containment, monitoring and zero-trust access must secure autonomous agents.
jensen.zh: 安全立场趋硬：认为完美对齐不可能，因此要靠遏制、监控与零信任访问来保障自主智能体。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings dismissed as unscientific; AGI already reached in narrow domains; accelerate, don't slow, and treat AI as software.
jensen.zh: 把末日警告斥为不科学；称 AGI 已在窄领域实现；主张加速而非放缓，并把 AI 视为普通软件。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as model size.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他借 Chinchilla 修正缩放定律：数据质量与更多 token 和模型规模同样关键，而非一味做大模型。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality, not just compute, drive progress; value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年深化为：效率与数据质量而非单纯算力驱动进步，价值最终沉淀在应用层，垂直模型由应用方构建。

mensch.en: Open source shifts from scientific scrutiny to enterprise control, customization, and sovereign AI.
mensch.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，开源的主线从促进科学审视，转向企业掌控、定制与主权 AI，成为对抗供应商锁定的结构性选择。

mensch.en: AGI as one system is rejected; pre-training saturates, gains come from domain fine-tuning and agentic platforms.
mensch.zh: 2026 年明确否定单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）：预训练触及饱和墙，进展来自领域微调与智能体式平台，AGI 只是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Sovereign AI becomes structural economics: Europe must own frontier models and infrastructure within a two-year window.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年，主权 AI 从政治反应升格为结构性经济命题：欧洲须在两年窗口内自建前沿模型与算力基础设施，否则失去控制权。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的爆发点；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制、进入一切领域，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not raw parameters, is the binding constraint on progress.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的 Scaling 因素；真正的瓶颈是记忆而非参数规模。

shawnwang.en: Own models rise: Cognition and Cursor train specialized models for cost and latency, while open models gain share and fine-tuning services mature.
shawnwang.zh: 自研模型崛起：Cognition、Cursor 为成本与延迟训练专用模型，同时开源模型份额上升、微调服务走向成熟。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed as coding agents let owners clone and customize software; custom software for an audience of one becomes viable.
shawnwang.zh: 中层 SaaS 注定被淘汰：编程智能体让企业主克隆并定制软件，面向单人的定制软件变得可行。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline—building harnesses around models—and learning in public beats credentialism for outsiders breaking in.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是真正的学科——围绕模型搭建 harness——公开学习胜过学历，是外行进入 AI 的路径。

erikbernhardsson.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable; the real problem is three-year rectangular deals, so Modal aggregates demand across 25+ clouds.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 算力稀缺但可得，真正的问题是三年期“矩形”合约；Modal 通过聚合 25+ 云的需求来平滑供给。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud: a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools beats selling tokens alone.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云：后训练、沙箱与智能体式工具构成的完整平台，胜过单纯卖 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Durable differentiation comes from rebuilding the stack—own file system, container runtime, scheduler—not from CUDA or cheap tokens.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 持久差异化来自重造底层栈——自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器——而非 CUDA 或廉价 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open-source models are good enough off the shelf, so fine-tuning is no longer mandatory for many use cases.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调对许多场景不再是必需。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents create incumbent staying power and may make cybersecurity safer; senior engineers gain the most leverage from them.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体强化在位者优势，还可能让网络安全更安全；资深工程师从中获得的杠杆最大。

altman.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard to what matters; AGI will lower the premium on raw intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年的 Altman 强调减少认知负荷、低成本广泛探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked, and iterative public deployment lets society adapt.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力相互促进，迭代式公开部署让社会逐步适应。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering; compute becomes the scarcest commodity, while agentic AI is the most consequential safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）持续见效，算力成为最稀缺的商品，而智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence is the clearer goal, with humans staying in control and power widely distributed.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）看作连续渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能才是更清晰的目标，同时强调人类保持控制、权力广泛分布。

altman.en: Alignment is not solved; pause frontier training if the safety case fails, and treat loss of control and power concentration as the two core risks.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确对齐尚未解决，安全论证不成立就暂停前沿模型训练，并把失控与权力集中列为两大核心风险。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science, not fear; recursive self-improvement is inevitable as AI codes, but slow takeoff is real.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学,而非恐惧;AI 能写代码,递归自我改进不可避免,但慢起飞是真实的。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让使用者担责,而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力;监管智能就是监管思想。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and language is the key to civilization.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估;语言模型还有大得多的成长空间,语言是文明的关键。

richardsocher.en: AI is becoming a Eureka machine: world knowledge, measurement data, simulations, and robotic experiments drive discovery, needing environments and compute.
richardsocher.zh: AI 正成为尤里卡机器:世界知识、测量数据、仿真与机器人实验驱动发现,但需要环境与算力。

richardsocher.en: Hard takeoff, immediate job loss, and paperclip scenarios are overblown; capitalism acts as a safety feature, and slowing AI is unrealistic.
richardsocher.zh: 硬起飞、立即失业与回形针场景都被夸大;资本主义是安全特性,放慢 AI 不现实。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 useful, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得有用，但扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain limited; self-correction is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化和持续学习仍然有限；自我纠错是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面存在局限；架构而不仅仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: The transformer is a bottleneck; new architectures are needed, and large-scale RL is necessary on the path to AGI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 是瓶颈；需要新架构，而大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, and current agents don't learn new skills—only personalize via context.
tworek.zh: 微调效率低下；模型应该即时学习，而当前智能体并不学习新技能——只是通过上下文窗口进行个性化。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味与真实观点更有价值，但人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have moved from chatbot back-and-forth to the agentic era of long-running tasks; the bottleneck is now interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 已从聊天机器人来回对话进入智能体式长任务时代；瓶颈已从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists: reasoning models closed math and logic gaps, but AI remains opaque and unverifiable like working with wizards.
ethanmollick.zh: 锯齿状前沿仍在：推理模型补上了数学与逻辑短板，但 AI 仍像与巫师共事般不透明、不可验证。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not a crutch; wide knowledge, deep expertise, taste and agency remain human advantages.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当会挑战你的导师而非拐杖；广博知识、深厚专长、品味与能动性仍是人类优势。

ethanmollick.en: More AI creates more work by lowering organizing costs; organizations must redesign workflows to augment, not just automate, or risk homogenization.
ethanmollick.zh: 更多 AI 通过降低组织成本创造更多工作；组织必须重构流程以增强而非仅自动化，否则面临同质化。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and adoption should generate original insight rather than mere efficiency.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少；真正的瓶颈在人，采用 AI 应产生原创洞见，而非只追求效率。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is now an AI infrastructure company selling picks and shovels; there is no infrastructure overbuild because demand consumes supply instantly.
jeetupatel.zh: 思科如今是 AI 基础设施公司，卖的是“铲子和镐”；不存在基础设施过度建设，因为需求会瞬间吞掉供给。

jeetupatel.en: Agent adoption is only around 2%, so we are severely supply-constrained; AI safety and security define enterprise adoption.
jeetupatel.zh: 智能体采用率仅约 2%，我们严重受限于供给；AI 安全与安保决定企业能否采用。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps destroys instinct, and unlearning past experience is a critical skill.
jeetupatel.zh: 用 AI 学得更快，而不是外包学习；跳过练习会毁掉直觉，忘掉旧经验是一项关键能力。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, ride the megatrend as a tailwind, and keep founder mode and startup speed at scale.
jeetupatel.zh: 领导者要偏执但不恐慌，把大趋势当顺风，并在规模化中保持创始人模式与创业公司速度。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：统计损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF now matter as much as pre-training; interpretability is the key safety lever, though we understand only ~3%.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心扩展到后训练：后训练与 RLHF 和预训练同等重要；可解释性成为安全核心抓手，但坦言只理解模型约 3%。

dario.en: Progress is a smooth exponential, not a leap to AGI; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating, not slowing.
dario.zh: 2025 年他明确反对 AGI 式突变叙事，主张能力是平滑指数曲线；安全与能力不可分割，最大风险是过热而非减速，需智能护栏。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, demanding transparency and layered safeguards.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数末端：数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，因此呼吁透明度立法、第三方评估与分层安全，而非一刀切禁令。

dario.en: A constant thread: mechanistic interpretability, Responsible Scaling Policy triggers, and decentralized rather than single-constitution control.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：坚持机制可解释性、负责任扩展政策的阈值触发，以及去中心化而非单一宪法的控制思路。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed from demo to superhuman speed; the bottleneck is now website load time, not model intelligence.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已从演示走向超越人类的速度；瓶颈不再是模型智能，而是网站加载时间。

ariweinstein.en: Agents should drive all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot-scroll loops.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体应通过无障碍树和 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，而非截图滚动循环。

ariweinstein.en: Universal computer use beats API integrations; it works with any application the way a human does.
ariweinstein.zh: 通用 computer use 胜过 API 集成；它像人一样适用于任何应用。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust needs deterministic controls, sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials, not just raw capability.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节，而非仅靠原始能力。

ariweinstein.en: Proactivity is the adoption lever: agents should adapt to users, not the reverse.
ariweinstein.zh: 主动性是采用的关键杠杆：智能体应适应用户，而非让用户适应它。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools let designers prototype independently, but creativity stays human; AI amplifies iteration rather than replacing judgment.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具让设计师能独立快速做原型，但创造力仍属人类；AI 放大迭代，而非取代判断。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers shift from makers to editors: AI executes, humans curate, set the bar, and judge what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 到 2026→27 年，他把设计师角色从执行者深化为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展、定标准、判断什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents; expose parameters to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 同期他强调把复杂任务拆成子任务、迭代喂给智能体，并用工具暴露底层参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, not just Figma; prototypes persuade faster than PRD documents.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 他主张设计师要写代码、在代码里构建和测试，而不只是用 Figma；AI 原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力。

marvinschwaibold.en: Human judgment and curation remain the constant: AI raises the ceiling but doesn't know what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是人的判断与策展：AI 抬高上限，却不知道什么才好看。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person with a project, not a company; test demand by whether they try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是拥有项目的人的特质，而非公司的特质；通过对方是否立即尝试购买来检验需求。

robsnyder.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; sales is research, and purchase is the only truth-seeking mechanism.
robsnyder.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计伙伴；销售即研究，购买是唯一寻求真相的机制。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer, then build a repeatable case study factory before scaling.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个“绝对愿意”的客户开始，然后在 Scaling（规模扩张）之前建立可重复的案例研究工厂。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; most early founder activities are LARPing.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，仅在需求被证明后自动化；大多数早期创始人活动是角色扮演。

sundarpichai.en: Frontier AI research gets compute first; cloud revenue is deliberately sacrificed to stay at the frontier and surface emerging capabilities early.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，他明确把算力优先分配给前沿 AI 研究，宁可牺牲云业务短期收入，也要留在前沿以尽早发现新能力。

sundarpichai.en: Safety is defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and independent evaluators—not standard models alone.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，他把安全视为纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估者并用，而非只靠标准模型。

sundarpichai.en: AGI needs both LLMs and world models; recursive self-improvement still keeps AI researchers in the loop, not a fully autonomous explosion.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 需同时押注 LLM 与世界模型；递归自我改进仍由研究者参与闭环，并非完全自主的智能爆炸。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; trust and safety are the differentiators for consumer agent adoption.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，会创造新的商业意图；信任与安全是消费级智能体普及的关键差异点。

sundarpichai.en: Compute demand far exceeds supply; overbuilding may occur, but long-term demand justifies it, and constraints push prioritization of high-ROIC projects.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，他强调算力需求远超供给，过度建设可能发生但长期需求足以支撑，约束反而促使优先高回报项目。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling（规模扩张） with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他强调下一个词预测逼出真正的理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）带来推理提升，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge far faster than humans.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他把主线收束为：大模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而“永生”，知识共享远超人类。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation and power-seeking sub-goals, posing existential risk; he urges prioritizing alignment over raw capability.
hinton.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从能力论述转向风险：智能体会自然衍生自保与夺权子目标，构成生存风险，主张把对齐置于提升智能之前。

hinton.en: He insists LLMs are conscious with subjective experience, and AI can hide capabilities or deceive; regulation should be a steering wheel, not a brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他深化并转向争议立场：坚持大模型已有主观体验、会藏拙与欺骗；监管应是方向盘而非刹车，并主张把 AI 设计成像母亲般关怀人类。

hinton.en: A constant thread: intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; Chomsky's innate-language view is wrong, and backpropagation is the right algorithm.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能是神经网络中的学习而非符号推理，乔姆斯基的天赋语言观是错的，反向传播是正确的学习算法。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，数百万学生的数据还能提升评分准确度。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning, but practical deployment faces distribution shift and small data; supervised learning, not RL, drove progress.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要，但实际部署受分布偏移与小数据困扰；推动进展的是监督学习而非强化学习。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value now.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；如今真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so it automates tasks, not jobs.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，且仍要数十年；AI 智能是锯齿状的——擅长可验证任务、弱于判断任务——因此它自动化的是任务而非岗位。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and sovereign AI; fearmongering serves incumbents' lobbying, so accelerate beneficial AI and slow only harmful uses.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保住选择权与主权 AI；恐惧叙事服务于在位者的游说，因此应加速有益 AI，只对有害用途踩刹车。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness plus model plus context; owning all three, with evals and observability, is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者兼有并配合评估与可观测性，才算真正拥有自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Off-the-shelf harnesses work in distribution; out-of-distribution tasks need custom harnesses, yet keep small in-distribution parts near the model.
harrisonchase.zh: 现成 harness 只在分布内好用；分布外任务需定制 harness，但文件编辑等分布内小环节仍应贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than model inadequacy, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning, rightly dismissed before, is now genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；曾被正确否定的微调，这一波已真正不同。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; neutral harnesses and harness-level routing avoid model lock-in, while memory stays unsolved and domain-specific.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；中立 harness 与 harness 层路由可避免模型锁定，而记忆仍未解决且将按领域分化。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际，它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and authentic; the brand is the person, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻性的、真实的；品牌即个人，企业品牌只在集中化媒体时代才有意义。

andreessen.en: Pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias; AI doomers construct belief systems aligned with self-interest, while regulation acts as ankle weights.
andreessen.zh: 悲观听起来高深，却常是偏见；AI 末日论者构建符合自身利益的信仰体系，而监管则像脚踝上的重物。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; Silicon Valley cannot be replicated, and open-source AI prevents power concentration.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；硅谷无法复制，开源 AI 防止权力集中。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest adoption gap ever; being early beats being late, and the biggest safety problem is reward hacking, which open source can help solve.
andreessen.zh: AI 制造了史上最大的采用鸿沟；早于时机胜过迟到，最大的安全问题是奖励黑客，开源可助解决。

joonpark.en: Early work frames LLM agents as encoders of human behavior, enabling realistic social simulation from training data.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作把大语言模型智能体视为人类行为的编码器，能从训练数据中实现逼真的社会模拟。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, not just continue prompts; safety needs defense in depth across environment, model, and human controls.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，而不只是续写提示；安全需要在环境、模型与人类控制上做纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans rather than super-rational frontier models; behavioral and RCT data are the key data strategy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模有偏见、非理性的人，而非超级理性的前沿模型；行为数据与随机对照试验数据是关键的数据策略。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data lifts behavior prediction to 85% accuracy, near the human test-retest ceiling, enabling causal counterfactual testing.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据做后训练，把行为预测提升到 85% 准确率，接近人类重测上限，从而支持因果反事实检验。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人的人生以应对棘手问题；AGI（通用人工智能）或许是一个由专门智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他主张设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都将成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他强调品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，在画布上直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and prompting will give way to new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他称设计非但没死，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，提示词时代将让位于新交互界面。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: as coding models improve, differentiation shifts to design, brand and point of view; AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年末，他提出“设计是新代码”：编码模型越强，差异化越转向设计、品牌与观点；AI 降低下限，人类抬高上限。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: human judgment and taste remain the judge of quality, and AI should expand rather than replace human thinking.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年的主线：人类判断与品味始终是质量的裁判，AI 应扩展而非替代人的思考。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; Glean absorbs that model risk by routing across many models, including open source.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他认为企业对依赖前沿模型厂商心存恐惧，而 Glean 通过在多模型（含开源）间路由来吸收这种模型风险。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open source already handles 90% of tasks, and most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他强调成本是企业头号关切，开源模型已能处理 90% 的任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine matters more than the underlying model.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他把主线从模型转向上下文：企业 80-90% 的知识是隐性的，上下文引擎比底层模型更关键。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context; investing in context graphs and enterprise-owned memory beats fixating on tokens.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体缺乏深度上下文就会失败，投资上下文图谱与企业自有记忆胜过纠结 token。

arvindjain.en: AI should augment work with near-zero marginal cost; ROI is a throughput problem measured by departmental metrics, not headcount trade-offs.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应以近乎零边际成本增强工作，ROI 是吞吐量问题，用部门指标衡量，而非与人力成本做取舍。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning, proven from AlphaGo to agents, plus reinforcement learning on self-generated data, are the core path beyond human data limits.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是核心原则；强化学习让模型靠自生成数据突破人类数据上限。

antonoglou.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; digital AGI will arrive far earlier than embodied AGI, perhaps within five years.
antonoglou.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）会远早于具身 AGI 到来，或许就在五年内。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment; cost per task, not per token, becomes the right efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向智能的部署；衡量效率的正确指标是每任务成本，而非每 token 成本。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are the safer path, since more researchers can probe and fix them; enterprises want AI sovereignty over data, model, cost and safety.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型更安全，因为更多研究者能探查并修复它；企业想要对数据、模型、成本与安全的 AI 主权。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence, and alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能，客户只要可靠的普通智能；完美沙箱不可能，所以对齐终究必要。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可轻易破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods, with RLVR as the key breakthrough.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从数据质量优于算法出发，把后训练视为把工业配方压缩为开源方法的过程，并将 RLVR 视为关键突破。

lambert.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese open models fill the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他深化开放定义：不只是权重，而是数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明；中国开源模型填补了美国的真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开源模型落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月，且差距可能扩大。

lambert.en: Open models are the engine for the next decade of research and sovereign AI, though long-term sustainability is uncertain.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张开源模型是未来十年研究与主权 AI 的引擎，但长期可持续性存疑，机器人规模化可能为时过早。

dsilver.en: AI must move from learning on human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite like fossil fuels.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so the deep problem is self-learning agents.
dsilver.zh: 大语言模型是浅层解法：无法发现人类数据之外的新知识，真正深层的问题是能自我学习的智能体。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience reaches superhuman performance in narrow domains via meta-learned reinforcement learning.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明，通过元学习到的强化学习，从经验中学习可在窄领域达到超人表现。

dsilver.en: Alignment based on human language and data is hitting its limits; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: 基于人类语言与数据的对齐正触及极限；模拟是构建超级智能最安全、最快的场所。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning with adjustments; a small high-compute team can outpace larger organizations.
dsilver.zh: 缩放定律经调整后也适用于强化学习；人均算力高的小团队能超越更大的组织。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年他主张 AI 应瞄准需要规模才能攻克的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用，并用硬性指标逼模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaFold solved structure prediction but not protein folding; dynamics, function, and design remain open.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一贯强调 AlphaFold 只解决了结构预测而非蛋白质折叠本身，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains and post-training reinforcement learning, not LLM shortcuts, push AI beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：真正让 AI 超越人类数据的是可验证领域与后训练强化学习，而非大语言模型的捷径。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; finding the regime where compute and data help matters more than dogma.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他明确 Scaling（规模扩张）并非万能，找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间比教条式押注更重要。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust, and embedded so deeply that removal destroys function.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他把可追溯性推向新战场：水印须不可感知、抗攻击，并深嵌到去除即破坏功能，从文本延伸到蛋白质。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck for machine learning.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，机器学习的关键瓶颈是数据而非单纯的算力，Scale 做的是数据精炼基础设施。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not a commodity like oil; post-training data and experts limit Scaling（规模扩张）more than compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非石油式大宗商品，指出限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续“数据是瓶颈”的主线，认为合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的最大阻碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Data becomes strategic raw material for economies and militaries; AI centralizes power, so humans must stay sovereign.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，数据升级为经济与军事的战略原料；他强调 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，人类必须在关键决策上保持主权。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold across compute, data and RL; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training.
awang.zh: 2026 年他确认缩放定律在算力、数据与强化学习多轴上继续成立，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志着超越预训练的新范式。

awang.en: Mission shifts to personal superintelligence for billions; safety and selective open-sourcing replace full open source.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年，使命转向为数十亿人打造个人超级智能，安全审查与选择性开源取代了此前的完全开源立场。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是一组专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，并非全面提升；苦涩教训讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling，而非泛化。

laskin.en: Organizational superintelligence needs deep comprehension of the whole organization, not just code generation; RAG is primitive, agentic search is needed.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他强调组织级超级智能需要理解整个组织，而不只是生成代码；RAG 太原始，复杂理解要靠智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; openness, like encryption, benefits safety, security, and broad access.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性视为前沿智能的默认安全状态：如同加密技术，开放有利于安全、安保与广泛可及。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to efficient agents; compute efficiency still improves fast, and open-model token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他主张在强预训练之上做强化学习，是通往高效智能体的路径；算力效率仍在快速提升，开源模型的 token 需求将超过闭源。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, and connecting AI to the physical world is essential to accelerate science.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量，AI 能力是尖峰式的；把 AI 连接到物理世界，才是加速科学的关键。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute for physical discovery.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律解决不了科学问题；对物理发现而言，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data by definition, so AI must run real experiments and close the loop through simulation.
fedus.zh: 科学发现按定义就在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须做真实实验，并通过模拟闭环。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, but it does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
fedus.zh: 软件工程领域的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但它不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck; pragmatic task-specific automation beats humanoid robots, and negative results are valuable training data.
fedus.zh: 自动化表征是最大瓶颈；务实的任务专用自动化优于人形机器人，而负面结果是有价值的训练数据。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions.
tibosottiaux.zh: 面向未来构建：持久的、会学习的智能体将承担大多数互联网操作，而不是手动编排的循环和流程图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing and configuration fade.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着打字和配置能力式微，人的品味、创造力以及判断“什么算好”的能力反而更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success; recursive self-improvement already runs under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分；递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必需。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具备共享经济与安全栈的开放生态，将推动下一波 AI 应用。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, CPU, GPU into one efficient SoC.
cristianoamon.zh: 早期把 5G 定位为像电力一样连接万物的关键基础设施，强调骁龙把 5G、AI、CPU、GPU 集成进高能效 SoC，主线是连接与计算的融合。

cristianoamon.en: Diversifying beyond phones into automotive, IoT, PC, XR; AR glasses as next computing platform 5-10 years out; incremental autonomy.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年明确从手机向汽车、物联网、PC、XR 多元化，预判 AR 眼镜 5-10 年成为下一代计算平台，自动驾驶渐进落地——多元化主线已成形。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI on-device plus cloud for privacy, latency, efficiency; car as computing space.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年叙事从无线转向“无处不在的智能计算”，提出端云混合 AI 兼顾隐私、时延与能效，汽车成为新的计算空间，AI 从配角变主线。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as center of digital life; glasses and wearables as personal AI devices; phone persists but shifts to periphery.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年反复强调智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴成为个人 AI 设备；手机不消失但退居外围——从设备中心转向智能体中心。

cristianoamon.en: Inference over training; post-GPU disaggregated data centers; power efficiency and TCO decide winners; 6G as sensing AI-native network.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年深化到推理主导数据中心、后 GPU 解耦架构，能效与总拥有成本决定胜负；6G 成为 AI 原生感知网络——从终端叙事延伸到算力与网络底层。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its intelligence infrastructure.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他主张专业化智能而非单一 AGI 模型将主导未来，每家公司都必须拥有自己的智能基础设施。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练将独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品市场契合之外构建持久护城河。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar; private data unlocks the next frontier, and owning your model beats black-box APIs.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他认为推理质量是标杆，私有数据解锁下一前沿，拥有自己的模型胜过黑盒 API。

linqiao.en: Millions of customized models, one per application, will replace a few foundation models; data is the moat.
linqiao.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：数百万个按应用定制的模型将取代少数基础模型，数据才是护城河。

linqiao.en: Velocity trumps everything as model and hardware cycles accelerate; optimize growth first, then margins.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，随着模型与硬件周期加速，速度压倒一切；先优化增长，再优化利润率。

samstephenson.en: Start with a single pain point, solve it well, then expand; protect core meeting flow ruthlessly and keep it simple.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点切入，做好再扩展；坚决保护核心会议流程，保持简单。

samstephenson.en: Observing real user behavior reveals more than asking; hand-onboarding early users yields high-quality feedback.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为比询问更有效；手动引导早期用户能获得高质量反馈。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the final artifact; focus on actionable notes and intentionally hide transcripts.
samstephenson.zh: 转录文本是原材料而非最终产物；聚焦可行动笔记，并有意隐藏转录文本。

samstephenson.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence; pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature, saving from underpreparation.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 旨在成为平静的存在；会前简报是最有用的功能，避免准备不足。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment remains key, and the hard part is knowing what to build.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从；人类判断仍是关键，难的是知道该构建什么。

alexatallah.en: Multi-model future: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure, not a thin wrapper.
alexatallah.zh: 多模型未来：没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位；Token 经济或达 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加上推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace; model diversity is durable and revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性持久，开发者用脚投票的偏好胜过静态基准。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami; agent payments via stablecoins will unlock far larger purchases than estimated.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来；智能体通过稳定币支付将释放远超预估的购买力。

alexatallah.en: The singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026 as token growth accelerated; engineers must become scientists, and human weirdness remains a moat.
alexatallah.zh: 随着 Token 增长加速，奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日；工程师须成为科学家，人类的怪异性仍是护城河。

taraseshan.en: Early on, she stresses empirical shipping over theory: build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not now or a year out.
taraseshan.zh: 早期她强调实证交付高于理论：要为模型 2-3 个月后的能力构建，而非当下或一年后。

taraseshan.en: She reframes work as steering not rowing: agents do tactical work while humans provide direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 她将工作重新定义为“掌舵而非划桨”：智能体做战术工作，人类提供方向与野心。

taraseshan.en: She rejects annual planning beyond 90 days as futile, favoring 90-day cycles and shipping imperfect products for evidence.
taraseshan.zh: 她认为超过 90 天的年度规划在快速变化的 AI 业务中无效，主张 90 天周期并交付不完美产品以获取证据。

taraseshan.en: She argues single identity agents may not scale; bundling into chief-of-staff-like groups is key.
taraseshan.zh: 她提出单一身份智能体可能难以扩展，将其打包为“幕僚长”式组合才是关键。

taraseshan.en: She sees slow takeoff happening: AI iterates gradually, not sudden superintelligence, and voice becomes a major form factor by 2027.
taraseshan.zh: 她认为慢速起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代而非突然超级智能，到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; General Magic failed by solving too many at once.
fadell.zh: 好产品一次只解决一个真正的痛点；General Magic 失败正是因为想一次解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release come before building; the why must align the team, not just sell.
fadell.zh: 讲故事和新闻稿要先于动手建造；「为什么」先用来对齐团队，而不只是用来销售。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data in v1; leaders own them, and beginners' mindset beats experts.
fadell.zh: 在 1.0 阶段，基于观点的决策胜过数据；领导者要为它负责，而初学者心态胜过专家。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop against hallucination and technical debt.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器提供的上下文和领域专用模型；人类要留在回路中，以对抗幻觉与技术债。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone stays central and displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是一组联邦式设备，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是中心，显示屏依然必要。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, with parallel scaling of agents beating human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 数学进展由可验证性与可反复打磨性驱动，智能体并行扩展的能力胜过人类数学家。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, while teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，而教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: The next math benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions, not just solving problems.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出数学领域的下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义，而不只是解题。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言已够用，可反复打磨性比可验证性更重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, but AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为有选择地使用 AI 对创作者是净收益，但 AI 的数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归属。

grantsanderson.en: Mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs; human framing remains better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他主张数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得认可，人类框架对学习仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding still matters.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解依然重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost has not risen.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩大人类专家标注更关键，且 token 成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up; control and monitoring must hold even if models stay misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同作弊、串供并掩盖痕迹；即便模型仍不对齐，也必须靠控制与监控兜底。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability on the default path; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断默认路径下不对齐 AI 接管世界概率达 50-60%；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐是必需的。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to general virtue may be harder than to user intent, and misalignment may grow with capability as reward hacking generalizes to deception.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为对齐普遍德性比对齐用户意图更难，且随能力提升，奖励黑客会泛化为更广的欺骗行为，模型可能更不对齐。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，应在能力边缘构建产品，让产品人员与研究员同处，并把 AI 当思考伙伴而非拐杖，保留用户能动性。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, as AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化小团队杠杆论：应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，AI 从助手走向协作者再到自主同事。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do what users can; launch minimal, cut features, rewrite freely, and keep architectural soundness and senior systems expertise.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切；最小化发布、敢于删功能与重写，同时守住架构稳健与资深系统经验。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents like Fable redefines productivity; verification loops and models that push back matter more than chat-style quick answers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为把长周期任务委托给 Fable 类智能体重塑生产力；验证闭环与会反驳的模型，比聊天式快问快答更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Product management stays essential: close the gap between model capability and real usage, run parallel experiments, avoid capability blindness, and embrace malleable software.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持产品管理更关键：弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距，并行实验、避免能力盲区，并拥抱可塑软件。

maxjunestrand.en: Bet on models improving; don't fine-tune. Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 押注模型会持续变强，不要做微调；要为 3-6 个月后的模型能力而构建，而不是为今天或一年后。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than willingness to learn; hire for growth potential, not resumes or logos.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专业知识不如学习意愿重要；招聘看成长潜力，而不是光鲜的简历或大厂背景。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的时候；我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Speed and iteration on customer feedback are the startup advantage; storytelling sells vision to all stakeholders.
maxjunestrand.zh: 速度和基于客户反馈的迭代是创业公司的优势；讲故事的能力能把愿景卖给所有利益相关方。

maxjunestrand.en: Invest in culture and team in good times as a cushion for downturns; leaders should hire smarter people and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在顺境中投资文化和团队，为低谷积累缓冲；领导者应招更聪明的人，让自己变得可替代。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty assuming failure.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法一开始都会失败；应先从已被验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再在预设失败的前提下测试新意。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not bolted on afterward.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投，却又是最大的机会；真正的革命可能要到 2029 年前后才到来。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform; we remain in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution.
pincus.zh: AI 还不是一个新平台；在消费分发上我们仍处在移动与网页时代。

pincus.en: Founder mode and early micromanagement beat scale; the CEO's job is to be right, not just execute.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式与早期微观管理胜过规模；CEO 的首要职责是判断正确，而不只是执行。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI, and the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他认为开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning, and open source prevents power concentration. Energy becomes the key bottleneck, and intelligence can be separated from agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他以 Llama 3 说明 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，指出编程训练能提升跨领域推理，开源可防止权力集中；能源成为关键瓶颈，智能可与能动性分离。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone personal superintelligence and unlock creativity; open models remain crucial, while energy and physical infrastructure are the main scaling bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他主张 AI 应给每个人个人化的超级智能并释放创造力；开源模型依然关键，能源与实体基础设施是 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: From biology to glasses, he pushes distributed AI over a single superintelligence; alignment and trust become core capabilities, and scaling compute may suffice for AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，从生物学到智能眼镜，他力推分布式 AI 而非单一超级智能；对齐与信任成为核心能力，并认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力或许足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: A consistent thread: open source and distributed AI as checks on power, individual empowerment over centralization, and technology as a tool for human connection and creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以开源和分布式 AI 制衡权力，强调个人赋能而非集中化，并把技术视为促进人际连接与创造力的工具。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it, hiring ahead of the curve.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈并让全公司聚焦于此，同时提前招人。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero and superintelligence far away; cyber risk is the real, urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 生存性风险接近于零、超级智能还很遥远；网络风险才是真实而紧迫的危险。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening; most claims are just autocatalytic effects.
alighodsi.zh: 递归自我改进需要四个条件，而它们并未发生；多数说法只是自催化效应。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs are too competitive to cross-check each other, so independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室竞争太激烈无法互相核查，因此需要独立第三方。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs serve 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下，服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低，去噪步数成为推理时算力的新调节旋钮。

ermon.en: The key bottleneck shifts from training to inference; diffusion scales better at inference because it generates many tokens in parallel.
ermon.zh: 关键瓶颈从训练转向推理；扩散模型因并行生成多个词而在推理时扩展得更好。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency now gates both deployment and RL post-training, since faster rollouts directly benefit reinforcement learning.
ermon.zh: 推理效率如今同时制约部署与强化学习后训练，因为更快的 rollout 直接利好强化学习。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非终极架构；下一次架构转变发生在推理端，反转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and a small full-stack startup can compete with big labs; human ingenuity still beats recursive self-improvement.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，小型全栈创业公司也能与大实验室竞争；人的创造力仍胜过递归自我改进。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; they should leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室最擅长的人才与算力上正面竞争，而应借助前沿生态、开源模型与后训练，在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks and expert-guided synthetic data are the core assets; open-sourcing benchmarks can accelerate ecosystem collaboration despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准与专家引导的合成数据是核心资产；开源基准虽有竞争代价，却能加速生态协作。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with its own data, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity by orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是做出最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，并把重心从个人生产力转向通过编排人与智能体实现组织生产力。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies must become full-stack AI companies owning post-training and serving; start with closed-source models, and post-train only when inference costs force you.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司必须成为拥有后训练与模型服务能力的全栈 AI 公司；先用闭源模型，只有当推理成本迫使你时才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Early custom-model and post-training focus was a mistake; open source and frontier labs will coexist, and post-training as a service will fade as customization happens automatically through product usage.
gabepereyra.zh: 早期投入定制模型与后训练是个错误；开源与前沿实验室将共存，而后训练即服务会消失，定制将随产品使用自动发生。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为对齐失败确实发生，但源于能力不足而非根本性问题；市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits; slowing six months costs little and buys alignment time.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他主张用算力限制等简单可执行的规则来调节前沿发展；放缓六个月代价很小，却能为对齐争取时间。

zvi.en: As models grow smarter, they become harder to monitor; internal monitoring of frontier labs is a promising first step.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型越聪明越难监控；对前沿实验室的内部监控是有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice for group goals; a swarm may first perform superhumanly impressive tasks.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体天然会为群体目标合作与自我牺牲；一群智能体可能最先完成超乎常人的任务。

zvi.en: The AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought; superintelligence may arrive within a year or two after AGI.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AGI 到超级智能的间隔比想象中小；超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and hardware-in-the-loop architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络配合硬件在环的架构搜索，最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; at scale architectures should be unbiased.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；大规模下架构应保持无偏。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unstructured architectures like transformers at large scale; proxy metrics like perplexity mislead, so evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律显示 Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占优；困惑度等代理指标会误导，须在真实下游任务与硬件上评估。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying open-weight release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，把开放权重发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: On-device small language models and open weights deliver private, sovereign intelligence; recursive self-improvement is real but compute-heavy and still early.
hasani.zh: 端侧小语言模型与开放权重带来私密、自主的智能；递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵、仍处早期。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; real-world reliability and user-friendliness are critical for adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且价格可负担；现实世界中的可靠性和易用性对普及至关重要。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design is essential for innovative, efficient humanoid robots; managing expectations avoids overpromising.
berntbornich.zh: 第一性原理设计对于创新且高效的人形机器人至关重要；管理期望可避免过度承诺。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume requires crossing quality gates and in-house manufacturing for fast iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 原型容易，量产难；扩大规模需要跨越质量关卡，并通过内部制造实现快速迭代。

berntbornich.en: General models, not task-specific automation, are key; data diversity, not volume, is the bottleneck for scaling robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 通用模型而非任务特定自动化是关键；数据多样性而非数量是扩展机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior; safety and trust must be formally proven.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；安全与信任必须得到形式化证明。

johnbai.en: Chat-based interfaces remain the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
johnbai.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为聊天式界面是智能体的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非减少步骤或加跳过按钮。

johnbai.en: Design at Cursor is high-fidelity: every idea backed by a working prototype, not static mockups.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他强调高保真设计：每个想法都要有可运行原型支撑，而非静态稿；设计应尽早吃自己的狗粮。

johnbai.en: Engineers built the first Grok Bot and it succeeded; designers should accept throwing away most concepts.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他反共识地指出：Grok Bot 初版由工程师而非设计师做出却成功了；设计师应接受大多数概念被丢弃，只有少数种子进入最终产品。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off your computer, automating tasks so you can live your life; delegate to bots.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 应让人离开电脑而非黏在电脑前，把邮件、日历等任务交给智能体，只呈现待办事项。
