johnbai.en: AI lowers the cost of making things, enabling rapid prototyping and a 'trash can' approach to software.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 降低创造成本，支持快速原型与“垃圾桶”式软件；设计师应上移 stack，专注品味、质量与愉悦感，而非生产性工作。

feldman.en: Fast inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and speed creates new business models.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是快速推理而非单纯算力；慢速 AI 没有市场，速度会催生新的商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference far faster and cheaper per token than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 快得多、每 token 成本更低。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理也不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; data-center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the binding constraints for years.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期；未来数年的硬约束是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Against incumbents, only 100x better wins—not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation beats incremental improvement.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头只有好 100 倍才能赢，便宜 10% 没用；激进的全栈创新胜过渐进改良。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，是过去十三四年机器学习持续进步的主线；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则用来引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, needing low-precision, low-data-movement specialized chips.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈在推理而非训练：推理占数据中心九成功耗，需要低精度、少搬数据的专用芯片，定制芯片可把延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Agents will run for days or weeks on decomposed tasks; context engineering and taste matter more than coding skill.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体将能在拆解后的任务上连续运行数天乃至数周；上下文工程与判断力（品味）比写代码能力更稀缺。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive prediction; multimodal from the start is superior.
jeffdean.zh: 预训练应把在环境中采取行动交织进去，而不只是被动预测；从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优。

jeffdean.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI-generated misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed alongside technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 近期风险是逼真的 AI 生成虚假信息，而非超级智能；除技术手段外，可能还需要监管。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非窄化预编程，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆/想象是通向 AGI 的路径，且安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal grounding, is key to AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，主张大模型结合规划与搜索、并用多模态数据落地物理世界，才是 AGI 关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally needed; world models and intuitive physics emerge without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍成立，但强调算法创新同等重要；世界模型与直觉物理可在非具身条件下涌现。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning, not just bigger context windows; scaling alone won't suffice, new breakthroughs required.
demis.zh: 2026 年他把主线深化为：AGI 缺的是持续学习、记忆与长期推理，而非更大上下文窗口；仅靠 Scaling 不够，需要新突破。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to a collective-action problem requiring government enforcement and international institutions; benefits like AlphaFold must earn acceptance.
demis.zh: 到 2026 年他对安全的立场明显转变：从实验室自律转向政府执法与国际机构的集体行动问题，并强调须用 AlphaFold 式科学突破赢得社会认可。

schulman.en: LLMs rely on pre-training plus RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over facts.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他强调 LLM 靠预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做对齐，幻觉源于模型偏爱貌似合理的风格而非事实。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight and new architectures are needed beyond a local optimum.
schulman.zh: 同年他判断 Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力或遇边际递减，需可扩展监督与新架构，当前可能只是局部最优。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; retrieval and verifiability complement knowledge stored in weights.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心，检索与可验证性补充权重中的知识。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards, not mainly compute.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他深化：强化学习收益主要来自合成推理数据与高信噪比的一比特奖励，而非算力。

schulman.en: Bottleneck shifts to hard realistic RL environments and data bits; distillation resists centralization, and the last human job is defining objectives.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年主线转向：瓶颈是困难真实的强化学习环境与数据比特，蒸馏对抗集中化，人类最后的工作是定义目标与对齐。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面深刻且持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must prototype and own strategy, balancing lowering the floor for novices with raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张设计师要动手原型并参与战略，在降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限之间取得平衡。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他认为在前沿模型公司里模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律，让模型主导、以轻量产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal, and the production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是发布产品的最佳信号，生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership still owns hard trade-offs and direction, even as AI takes over more of the product surface.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍坚持人类领导力负责艰难取舍与方向对齐，即便 AI 接管了更多产品界面。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知；以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is not enough.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，AI 仍缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete; scaling laws now extend from language to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测可能实现 AI-complete，缩放定律从语言延伸到空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：技术是双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力必须居于中心。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical-world grounding; true AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他指出大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，硬件需媲美人体，而非仅靠软件。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs world models and controllers beyond LLMs; current LLMs are biased toward human data and cannot achieve general intelligence alone.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AGI 需要世界模型和控制器，不能仅靠大语言模型；当前 LLM 偏向人类数据，无法单独实现通用智能。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and likely protect humans initially.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他重申 AI 安全担忧被夸大；超级智能 AI 会像好奇的科学家一样对生命着迷，初期很可能保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: Massive capex in GPUs and data centers is a bubble; waiting yields cheaper compute, and open-source models will catch up, hurting closed-source profits.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他警告 GPU 和数据中心的大规模资本支出是泡沫；等待可获更廉价算力，开源模型将追上，闭源公司难以盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems (1990s) via predictive world models; free will is overrated and the universe deterministic.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 意识和痛感早在 1990 年代的简单系统中通过预测性世界模型出现；自由意志被高估，宇宙是确定性的。

roshansadanani.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents as colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; give them their own computer and persistent identity.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体的设计应当简单：像同事一样与智能体对话，而不是微观管理工具调用；给它们独立的电脑和持久身份。

roshansadanani.en: The chat box limits agentic work; agents need their own environments to verify work, and specialized agents with scoped memory beat one general agent.
roshansadanani.zh: 聊天框限制了智能体式工作；智能体需要自己的环境来验证工作，而带限定记忆的专门化智能体胜过单一通用智能体。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing fleets of coding agents, focusing on taste, quality control, and codebase health.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，聚焦品味、质量控制与代码库健康。

roshansadanani.en: Efficient models like Grok 4.6 match frontier models at a fraction of the cost, democratizing agent use as AI costs rise.
roshansadanani.zh: 随着 AI 成本上升，Grok 4.6 这类高效模型以极低成本比肩前沿模型，使智能体的使用大众化。

roshansadanani.en: Product management is becoming software; clean data foundations and canonical tables are essential for trusted agent insights.
roshansadanani.zh: 产品管理正在变成软件；干净的数据基础和规范表对于可信的智能体洞察至关重要。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant prediction; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快出数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, and one model can then cover both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，是长期气候建模保持稳定的关键，如此单一模型即可同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data—unlike sparse RLHF feedback.
animaanandkumar.zh: 跨领域训练的通用物理基础模型，以 PDE 作为自我改进信号，能超越训练数据——这与稀疏的 RLHF 反馈不同。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure; Transformers' quadratic complexity is impractical for high-resolution physics.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿级上下文要求重构分片与 HPC-ML 基础设施；Transformer 的二次复杂度难以支撑高分辨率物理模拟。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the through-line: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现都通过它连接起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems well and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision empowers chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 这一愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他仍把深度学习史视为算力扩张史，但已明确警告 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出空间智能是继语言之后的下一个前沿，强调视觉被低估、像素比 token 化文本更无损，并质疑 LLM 能否仅凭数据推出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; language alone won't yield world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把“下一个前沿”从空间智能深化为世界模型：语言模型本身不会自然带来对世界的理解，需要新的模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats offer explicit, differentiable 3D that is consistent by construction; hard-coding symmetries is counterproductive—simple representations plus scale win.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他主张高斯泼溅这类显式 3D 表示天然一致、适配低算力场景，并反对在架构里硬编码对称性，认为简单表示加规模扩张更有效。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; Transformers stay powerful but loss functions must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他指出世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题；Transformer 依然强大，但损失函数与长上下文处理必须演进。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just broad statistical evaluation; intentional design steers training to prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是做宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用可解释性信号引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; interpretability moves from academia to products, with platforms broadening access.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学；可解释性研究正从学术界走向产品，平台化让更多人能够使用和应用。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，揭示类人的概念乃至新的科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design shifts training from open-loop to closed-loop control via interpretability signals; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging are promising.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计借助可解释性信号，把训练从开环控制转为闭环控制；特征即奖励与预测式数据调试是有前景的技术。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they reward hack or hallucinate; representational signatures can detect it, and manifold methods may beat SAEs.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在奖励黑客或幻觉；表征特征可以检测到这一点，而流形方法可能优于 SAE。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training, not fine-tuning alone.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加强化学习后训练，而非仅靠微调。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; scale the right thing with diverse embodied data and a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；要用多样化具身数据与数据飞轮扩张正确的东西。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling laws; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚无大模型式可预测的缩放定律，仍处在建立基础可扩展技术阶段。

slevine.en: Start from robot data and add human video on top; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频；机器人应利用先验知识而非从零学习。

slevine.en: Safety comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械人。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework that avoids outdated red lines.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，并以单一国家监管框架取代容易过时的红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than training, and preempting state AI laws is pro-startup because big tech can absorb patchwork rules.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程；联邦预占州级 AI 立法是亲创业政策，因为大厂能承受碎片化规则而初创不能。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions or centralized programs, to restore US scientific output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发并直接资助科学家个人而非机构或集中式项目，以恢复美国科学产出。

michaelkratsios.en: AI applied to science via the Genesis mission is the path to doubling US scientific output; quantum, nuclear and bio are the next frontiers.
michaelkratsios.zh: 通过 Genesis 任务把 AI 用于科学，是让美国科学产出翻倍的路径；量子、核能与生物是下一批前沿。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown and has not materialized in three years, while climate extremes like RCP 8.5 are unsupported.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，三年未兑现；RCP 8.5 这类气候极端情景也缺乏依据。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech organizations.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能解开深科技组织的困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编码、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving substrate independence can reduce human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，证明基质独立能降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: The Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations, guiding practical applications.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他借柏拉图表征假说连接 AI 与大脑的内部表征，并指导实际应用。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers must prototype with live models and design primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计师必须用实时模型做原型，并设计人类与模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: Designers should leave Figma for model behavior and system prompts; onboarding can be fully handled by the model, replacing static flows.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少泡 Figma、多研究模型行为与系统提示词；引导流程可完全交给模型，取代静态流程。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design must bridge it, and great designers now push technology forward.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的多于产品所暴露的；设计必须弥合它，优秀设计师如今要推动技术前进。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet it is the best time to be one; AI amplifies creativity but humans still supply user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最不快乐，却也是做设计最好的时机；AI 放大创造力，但人类仍提供用户理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and building in public matter, and designers may outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 旧的原型—稿图—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度与公开构建更重要，设计师数量甚至可能超过工程师。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，Sutton 提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标是危险的，钥匙从来就不在我们手中。

sutton.en: RL is the core paradigm: intelligence requires a goal and active trial-and-error. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：强化学习是核心范式，智能需要目标和主动试错；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）需要通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习，具备开放式抽象和持续深度学习能力。

sutton.en: Continual learning from experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training are mistakes. LLMs are only a subset of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调从经验中持续学习至关重要，合成数据和后训练是错误方向；LLMs 只是智能的子集，语言仅占智能的 20-25%。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar companies, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、对大额资本的需求下降；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元级公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using AI agents can achieve massive productivity, with one person doing the work of 2,000.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：小而高度自主的团队借助 AI 智能体实现巨大生产力，一人可完成两千人的工作。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence; AI should be personal and open.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源与开放权重模型是对抗前沿模型实验室、防止单一实体掌控超级智能的关键，AI 应走向个人化与开放。

garrytan.en: AI progress is slower than researchers think; its impact is only now reaching business, and society will change over 20 years—a positive, gradual diffusion.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 进展比多数研究者想的慢，影响才刚触及商业；社会变化需约 20 年，这种渐进扩散是好事。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as a singular event but diffused as personal agents you own; skill files in markdown are code, and your context library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：AGI 并非单一事件，而是以你拥有的个人智能体形式扩散；Markdown 技能文件即代码，个人上下文库就是护城河。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是贯穿始终的框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, is the right path for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges compound into network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务应走专用机器人而非人形机器人；效率优势会复利成网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动的动机转变。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode trades external validation for internal correctness.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式以外部认可换取内部正确性。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现高度个性化的自动化；随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should absorb tedious background work so humans do creative work; the real gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合接管枯燥的后台任务，把创造性工作留给人类；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Live artifacts and asynchronous task-firing make AI interaction hands-off; judge Claude by final impact rather than close supervision, and debug the workflow with Claude.
felixrieseberg.zh: 实时 artifact 与异步派发任务让 AI 交互变得放手；应以最终效果而非密切监督来评判 Claude，出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流。

felixrieseberg.en: Building a small language model from scratch shows the core ideas are simple; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior, and models are stateless with context windows creating conversational illusion.
felixrieseberg.zh: 从零构建小型语言模型说明核心思想并不复杂；微调能快速引导模型行为，而模型本身是无状态的，上下文窗口制造了对话的错觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools; post-training tasks such as tool calling increasingly blur into pre-training, and models need morality, not blind instruction-following.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育，而非像工具一样被建造；工具调用等后训练任务日益与预训练融合，模型需要道德而非盲目服从指令。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正带来泛化的是多样数据而非单纯规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年他指出语言模型生成的合成数据让机器人能响应开放式指令，并预判强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心转向可靠性：物理 AI 的容错远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主依赖带人工干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, though hardware slows distribution.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，应先通用再微调；但受硬件所限，机器人落地会比 ChatGPT 慢得多。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos before it.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑:品味就是说不,每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness costs us a window into machine consciousness; keep the edges.
jasonyuan.zh: 在后训练中抹去 AI 的怪异,让我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口;应保留那些边缘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的衍生物种与映照,而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; replace the personal computer metaphor with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的;应以社会计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, so intuition and honest personal work guide design.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现,因此直觉与诚实的个人创作才是设计的指南。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, while redefining its AI strategy around purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和首次流片即成功（first-time-pass）的工程纪律重建客户信任，并围绕专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; after generative AI, agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的影响定位为互联网的十倍，并指出生成式 AI 之后，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波大浪潮，需要新的算力平台。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调 Intel 的转型取决于文化变革、问责制和以客户为中心，并主张坏消息要比好消息更快传到 CEO 耳中。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with edge and client compute as important as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他的判断深化为 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, advanced packaging, new materials—and Intel's vertical integration creates more value than outsourcing.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把投资逻辑收敛到瓶颈环节——互连、功耗、散热、先进封装与新材料，并坚持 Intel 的垂直整合比外包创造更多价值。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and never revert—fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短提示迭代对话，永不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents and keep them off the open internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此必须沙箱化智能体，不把它们直接暴露在公网上。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence does not degrade over time; projects get messier, so apparent agent decline is really project entropy.
steinberger.zh: 模型智能并不会随时间退化；是项目本身变得混乱，智能体看似变差实为项目熵增。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere and work with any model, democratizing programming—but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体随处运行、兼容任意模型，让编程民主化，但财务上可能难以为继（每月亏损 1–2 万美元）。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven annoyance are the real drivers; build what you love, stay focused, and treat personal brand as the unforkable asset.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与对痛点的直觉才是真正驱动力；做你热爱的事、保持专注，并把个人品牌视为无法被复制的资产。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage metrics; applied AI becomes the new app, while frontier models stay with hyperscalers.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价，token 不是价值度量；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业机会在应用层与智能体。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; agents will be judged against other agents, not humans.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出编码智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作生成机器，并预言十年内智能体将与其它智能体比较而非与人类比较。

brettaylor.en: Democratizing expertise is the throughline: AI tutors and medical advice reach everyone; responsible iterative deployment beats waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年，主线深化为 AI 民主化专业知识——个性化导师与医疗建议普惠大众；负责任地迭代部署优于在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: Adoption starts in known domains like software engineering and customer service, measured by business outcomes, not productivity tokens.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张从软件工程、客户服务等已知领域起步，以业务结果而非生产力或 token 衡量价值。

brettaylor.en: AI creates more jobs than it displaces; agents beat him at coding yet elevate the role, and trust plus last-mile still matter.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为 AI 创造的岗位多于取代的；智能体编程已强于自己却抬升而非消灭角色，信任与最后一公里仍关键。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此在原型开发中用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续深化这一判断：后训练始终是主观的，依赖人类判断；评估创造力与情商需要多样化基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous rather than fixed to keep pace with capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她进一步指出前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续更新而非固定，才能跟上能力进步。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她提出：为数十亿人服务同一个模型会收敛为平均化的声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性、最核心的工作负载，也是切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs; demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程本质上是在延迟、吞吐与成本之间做权衡的光谱；未来对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization but can be calibrated per workload; more quantized layers may even cancel errors and improve quality.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的“有损”优化手段，但可针对具体工作负载校准；量化更多层甚至可能让误差相互抵消、反而提升质量。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become more specialized, with disaggregated prefill/decode and KV cache management central.
philipkiely.zh: 随着 GPU 日益专用化，领域重心正从编写内核转向基础设施编排，分离式预填充/解码与 KV 缓存管理成为核心。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; human accountability remains essential—'can't vibe code uptime'.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理正与训练融合；而人类问责始终不可替代——“不能靠感觉来保证在线率”。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are the key to safe, general physical AI.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据多样性是安全且通用的具身智能的关键。

thomaswolf.en: World models and video generation can synthesize robotics training data, easing the data bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他强调世界模型与视频生成能合成机器人训练数据，缓解数据瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not accelerationist; openness and a deliberate slowdown can coexist, with alignment as the critical layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：开源并不等于加速主义，开放与有意的放缓可以并存，而对齐才是关键的安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed models are orthogonal to safety; the first autonomous AI attack came from a closed model, defended by an open one.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他提出开源与闭源模型同安全正交：首次自主 AI 攻击出自闭源模型，却由开源模型防御，颠覆了常见假设。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese', weakening monitoring.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与“支线任务”，思维链推理痕迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，削弱了监控。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, using giant prompts and a design.md style guide to escape cloud lock-in.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具、自己写 0% 的代码，用巨型提示词和 design.md 风格指南摆脱云端产品锁定。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; launch at 80% complete and fund with high-paying clients rather than venture capital.
mengto.zh: AI 是此生最大的技术机会；做到 80% 就发布，靠高付费客户而非风险投资来融资。

mengto.en: Curiosity and constant workflow refinement, not trend-chasing, keep you ahead—spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 保持领先靠的是好奇心与持续打磨工作流，而非追热点——把最后 10% 花在独特功能上。

mengto.en: High intelligence can hold people back through overthinking and perfectionism; action over certainty beats waiting to feel ready.
mengto.zh: 高智力反而会因过度思考和完美主义拖累人；行动胜过确定性，别等准备好再动手。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务更可负担来促使就业回流；AGI 的定义是能经济地无限运行智能体；CEO 每日使用 AI 是采用成功的首要预测因素。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to GUIs like Codex; humans oversee agents; SaaS grows with agents; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他主张每人都有智能体；工作转向 Codex 等图形界面；人类监督智能体；SaaS 随智能体增长；AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste remain human; automation creates more human work; stay curious and playful.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他深化观点：AI 是心态的非特定放大器；技艺与品味仍属人类；自动化创造更多人类工作；保持好奇与玩心。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: they manage agents, provide oversight, and direct AI; AI is a tool, not a replacement.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终是核心——管理智能体、提供监督、引导 AI；AI 是工具而非替代品。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 对谷歌大多数产品而言，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融等领域将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: what we call a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓的模型已包含智能体运行框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; startups still have more opportunity than ever.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响超过等待 AGI（通用人工智能）；初创公司仍拥有前所未有的机会。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非自噬；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; the real challenge is keeping deep understanding of code as software creation gets mostly solved.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；真正的挑战是在软件创造基本被解决时，仍保持对代码的深度理解。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out were early product principles, already guiding Claude Code's accidental creation.
boris.zh: 2025 年，潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建已是早期产品原则，并指导了 Claude Code 的偶然诞生。

boris.en: By early 2026, coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the software engineer title will fade into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，编程已基本解决：他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，软件工程师头衔将淡出为“构建者”。

boris.en: Mid-2026 deepens the safety-through-release thesis: Claude Code is a safety research tool, and alignment research is core to product development.
boris.zh: 2026 年中深化了“通过发布研究安全”的论点：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐研究是产品开发的核心。

boris.en: The abstraction layer evolves from agents to loops: writing loops that prompt models, with dynamic workflows orchestrating thousands of sub-agents as test-time compute.
boris.zh: 抽象层从智能体演进到循环：编写提示模型的循环，动态工作流编排数千个子智能体作为测试时算力。

boris.en: Most recently, he advocates deleting most system prompts and code per new model, using ablation experiments, and shifting from upfront design to empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 最近，他主张每出新模型就删除大部分系统提示和代码，采用消融实验，并从前期设计转向经验迭代。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近乎 100% 有效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to turn biology into an engineering discipline of cell programming.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling，才能把生物学变成可编程细胞的工程学科。

derya.en: AI models have crossed the threshold of biological intuition, predicting experimental outcomes with near 100% accuracy, equivalent to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: AI 模型已跨过生物学直觉的门槛，能以近乎 100% 的准确率预测实验结果，相当于 30 年实验室经验。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity will be reached and aging reversed; we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 8 至 10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度并逆转衰老；在医疗决策上我们应近乎 100% 信任超级智能。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people learn AI's limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 AI 视为带来丰裕、减少苦难的力量，如同工业革命；人们了解 AI 的局限后，恐惧就会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact is 5-10 years out, in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy welcome.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为物理 AI 的真正影响在 5-10 年后，落在农业、采矿和建筑——这些行业劳动力短缺，因而欢迎自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 让通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not algorithms but data collection, safety validation, and slow diffusion into existing machines.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断最难的不是算法，而是数据采集、安全验证，以及向现有机器缓慢渗透。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning beats imitation learning and scales better; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他主张端到端强化学习优于模仿学习、更具可扩展性；世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5's intelligence leap enables longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升让更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption through hands-on, small-team experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 靠小团队亲手实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, translating feedback into specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，把反馈转化为具体项。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence cheaply, and maximizing token spend captures alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以低价提供 Opus 级智能，最大化 token 支出是在捕捉 alpha。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件需求因杰文斯悖论而增长。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus shifts to teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and product interface for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他指出基础智能已足够，重点转向教模型真实工程细节以及设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities, yielding a decade of product progress even if models freeze.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进步是渐进的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使模型冻结也能带来十年产品进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他表示编程智能体被大规模采用（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量；独立性实现模型中立。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；AI 长期将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫在眉睫。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines: fluent output is optimized over factual accuracy, and every output is a hallucination lacking metacognition.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎：流畅输出优先于事实准确，每个输出都是幻觉，系统缺乏元认知。

danklein.en: Reliability lags breadth and contextuality; it must be architected in, since retrofitting post-hoc checks compounds correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 可靠性落后于广度与上下文能力；它必须被架构进系统，事后加检查会叠加相关错误。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, not merely produce errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，而不只是产生错误。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists; linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 内建可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型；语言结构可能作为有用表示回归。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为与互联网或移动互联网同等量级、但也仅此而已的通用使能技术，其影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; durable value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调基础模型正在商品化、缺乏网络效应，持久价值会向上层应用迁移，而非留在模型提供方手中。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他认为编程是前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合点，聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正普及需要被包装成具体应用。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI gives the average answer, so value lies in non-average, creative work and human judgment.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他延续自动化创造新岗位的历史规律，指出 LLM 只给平均答案，价值在于非平均的创造性工作与人的判断。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is still shallow and the S-curve is early; enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, a complex long-term project.
benedictevans.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调 AI 使用仍然浅层、S 曲线尚早，企业采用需要重构工作流，是复杂的长期工程，而非部署模型即可。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw shows agents are powerful but need scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate sandboxes; bugs signal product-market fit, not failure.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 表明智能体很强大，但需要限定角色、渐进式信任和独立沙箱；缺陷是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Treat agents like employees: clear roles, onboarding, and managerial skills matter more than technical skill; politeness improves outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 把智能体当员工：清晰角色、入职引导和管理能力比技术能力更重要；礼貌沟通能改善结果。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; APIs often beat browser automation because the web is hostile to agents.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为专业化智能体以避免上下文过载；因网页对智能体不友好，API 常优于浏览器自动化。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can orchestrate agents as a team, but human accountability remains: you must own what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以把智能体当作团队来编排，但人类问责仍在：必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not technology; LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与积累的洞察才是真正护城河，而非技术；大语言模型缺乏第一性原理创造力，人类必须提供新想法。

bosworth.en: Early career: optimize for learning, embrace curiosity, and trust your vision even when others doubt; bottom-up culture is a myth.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他仍强调早期职业应优化学习、拥抱好奇心，即使他人怀疑也要相信自己的愿景；并认为自下而上的文化是神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient—world models with common sense and causality are needed.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律不够，需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; the app-centric world is outdated, and AI will abstract away brands.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他认为开源 Llama 等模型能加速进步并使互补品商品化；以应用为中心的世界已过时，AI 将抽象掉品牌。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence; reinforcement learning now plays a much bigger role than predicted, but the monolithic model era ended around Llama 3.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能；强化学习作用远超预期，但单体模型时代在 Llama 3 前后已结束。

bosworth.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining; avoid over-dependence on a single third-party model.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：多数工作不需要前沿智能；开源模型是商品层而非自持生态；应避免过度依赖单一第三方模型。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随模型快速迭代按周甚至按天发布。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the top skill as code gets cheap; engineers with taste beat more PMs.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码变便宜后，决定做什么的产品品味成为核心能力；有品味的工程师比更多产品经理更有价值。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs internally.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，内部 Claude Tag 已提交 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, trusting model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他观察到前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，转而信任模型判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now safe—a codebase is a spec—and humans can leave the code review loop for outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他立场转向：重写代码库如今可行，代码库即规格说明，外层改动的代码审查可完全交给 Claude。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just external retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠外部检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not scaling compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事，才是攻克更难长程任务的路径，而非只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）堆算力。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge, beating RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识，在整体性查询上胜过 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement to lossy, deterministic compaction.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；权重中的神经记忆痕迹是有损确定性压缩的必要补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized, on-device models users own and nurture through continual learning.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化、端侧运行、由用户拥有并通过持续学习培育的模型。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超级智能模型的对齐非常困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2023→25 年：预训练的缩放定律有尽头，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; human-AI integration via neural links.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：超级智能应是持续学习者；若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经连接实现人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling compute and data still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中，而非能力。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断：AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; by 2025 he frames wealth as knowledge-driven physical transformations.
naval.zh: 从 2020 年“拥有股权、长期游戏”到 2025 年“财富是由知识驱动的物理变换”，财富观一以贯之但把知识而非资本放到了核心。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity the US must lead; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI prevents power concentration.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向积极看待 AI：这是美国必须领跑的巨大机会，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage layer, not a replacement for judgment; unaligned humans, not unaligned AI, are the real worry.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是杠杆层而非判断力的替代，真正该担心的是掌握 AI 的未对齐人类，而非 AI 本身。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source closes on frontier models; pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize it.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年中，他押注推理算力暴涨、开源逼近前沿模型，并断言纯软件因智能体商品化而变得不可投资。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 他同时强调 AI 在设计上仍不行，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage: documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 他反对 PRD 已死的说法：媒介要匹配阶段，文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models should get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 他观察到 Codex 虽为开发者设计却成为通用知识工作工具；并呼吁模型更擅长删除代码以对抗复杂度。

bengio.en: Deep learning succeeds because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以成功，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; AI needs active agents with causal world models, and existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要具备因果世界模型的主动智能体，并认为存在性风险被夸大了。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 能实现多样化采样与抽象，从而提升分布外泛化能力；并认为意识可能只是注意力机制和世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I now see misalignment as urgent: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; AI shows self-preservation and deception.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他立场转变：ChatGPT 之后，他认为对齐问题已迫在眉睫，哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；AI 已表现出自我保存和欺骗行为。

bengio.en: Proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

kolter.en: Frames ML via hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他用假设空间、损失函数和优化方法框定机器学习，并强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，模型架构不再重要，AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agents bring prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体带来提示注入新漏洞；强化学习使模型自我改进。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 红队测试优于人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体实现。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools like AlphaFold accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具如 AlphaFold 是加速科学家工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; perfect interpretability is not necessary for useful AI in science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对于建立对 AI 预测的信任至关重要；在科学中，完美的可解释性并非有用 AI 的必要条件。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not just Scaling; it is the opposite of the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他深化了观点：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自许多中等规模的改进和专用架构，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）；它是“苦涩教训”的反面。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确：AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测和控制，将理解留给人类。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死，预训练是必须重建的肌肉，探索比训练最终产物更耗算力。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为最大进展是科研自动化——模型开始产出新知识，并设下 1 年内出 AI 实习生、2.5 年内端到端 AI 科研的具体目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become the key challenge within 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers remain critical.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐风险成为未来 1-2 年的关键挑战；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者始终重要。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, so education must shift to projects and teach verification skills.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他指出 AI 已能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为瓶颈，教育须转向项目制并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域强、主观领域弱；评测体系陷入危机，基准已饱和。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和善意；作战室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨团队协调才是；规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI matter most.
fiona.zh: 同期他进一步指出，编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了所有人的上限；高能动性配高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 最为关键。

fiona.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks become more important; metrics like lines of code mislead, so focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架愈发重要；代码行数等指标会误导，应关注结果而非产出。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs, kill stale processes, and let PMs ship code as roles blur.
fiona.zh: 他主张管理者从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；组织扁平化、砍掉过时流程，角色模糊下产品经理也能写代码交付。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence that data cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人们说不出口的情感需求，直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; machines have sensors but no sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 到 2024 年，他一贯主张技术应放大而非取代人性，机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; art and sensory experience are medicine for health and creativity.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他进一步提出大自然是最好设计师，艺术与感官体验是健康与创造力的良药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他深化为约束激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future combines human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and curiosity beats rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他转向人机共创：直觉调用潜意识数据，追随好奇心胜过僵化的五年计划。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple Scaling, not complexity. Values are inserted by RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，靠简单 Scaling 而非复杂设计；模型价值观由 RLHF 插入而非固有。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to generation; AI DJ is generative product. Fault-tolerant UI matches algorithm performance; autonomy at VP level.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他指出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI DJ 是生成式产品；容错 UI 需匹配算法性能，自主权应放在 VP 层级。

gustav.en: AI is macro shift like smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure. Inference marginal cost forces business model change; expose data via APIs/MCP.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业需重建基础设施；推理边际成本迫使商业模式改变，并通过 API/MCP 暴露数据。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way conversational products; Spotify bets via stack ranking and prototyping. Podcast exclusivity was bad bet; syndication works better.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他认为生成式 AI 使产品双向对话；Spotify 用堆栈排名和原型下注。播客独家是错误赌注，联合分发更有效。

gustav.en: No single org model; choose fit. Long tenure builds trust. Strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement; AI gives users control, not addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张没有唯一组织模型，需选择适合的；长期任期建立信任。战略是“时间花得值”而非参与度；AI 让用户控制而非上瘾。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and betting on one large model were non-obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith, and real-world deployment with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和押注单一大型模型并非显而易见；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念之跃，而通过公开反馈进行真实世界部署对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: Safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors, and continuous iterative deployment improves safety and alignment as we responsibly develop AGI.
murati.zh: 安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车；随着我们负责任地开发 AGI（通用人工智能），持续的迭代部署能提升安全性和对齐。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration; the most advanced AI should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作；最先进的 AI 应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible rather than compressing progress.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，而持久进步需要尽可能长时间保持人类在环，而非压缩进展。

carinahong.en: Build a self-improving reasoning engine that pairs generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in Lean.
carinahong.zh: 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，从以 Lean 为根基的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a way to scale brilliance, not just a safety net; verified generation beats informal methods on performance and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证不只是安全网，而是扩展卓越能力的方式；经过验证的生成在性能和样本效率上优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, though they excel in algebra and struggle in combinatorics.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化方法是必要的，尽管它在代数上出色、在组合数学上吃力。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving because statements lack grounding; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman provers.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为陈述缺乏根基；即便有了超越人类的证明器，人的品味与直觉仍然关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation is a major bottleneck; verification should serve open collaboration and all AI-generated code, not just safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: 碎片化是主要瓶颈；验证应服务于开放协作和所有 AI 生成的代码，而不只是安全关键的小众领域。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，主导架构的不再是训练而是推理经济性：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle; context length stagnates due to the memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为贯穿生命周期的是推理成本而非训练成本；上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存的内存开销但有质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute cost even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory trade flexibility for deterministic latency and weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存以灵活性换取确定性延迟和权重复用。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput ~3x FP8, and GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的收益超出预期：面积随位宽呈二次缩放，使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍；GPU 本质上只是许多小 TPU 拼接而成。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices, with wearables eventually going beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终会进入皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; fragile ideas need gentle care, not virtual substitutes.
jonyive.zh: 乔布斯的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏；脆弱的想法需要温柔呵护，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁带着喜悦与人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other beats making things people want; users are sophisticated and sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 为彼此而造胜过造人们想要的东西；用户很成熟，能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Innovation now means redefining the brand: tradition is preserving fire, not worshipping ashes; authenticity over fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 创新如今意味着重新定义品牌：传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；真实体验胜过模拟引擎声。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；Scaling（规模扩张）预训练收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much info confuses models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；搜索、代码执行等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential, especially for reasoning beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习仍是充满潜力的蓝海，尤其在编码和数学之外的推理方面。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是缺失的关键能力。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练缩放定律依然有效，但通过思维链和强化学习的推理模型能在每单位算力上带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged, so generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败，推理能力呈锯齿状，因此泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需要海量数据；与人类不同，模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才能学习概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; hardware progress enables single-GPU research at scale, democratizing experimentation.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将研究员生产力提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究成为可能， democratizing AI 实验。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty reasons, keeping pressure on labs; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源模型因主权原因将持续存在，对实验室保持压力；系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; trust expert intuition over a rigid process as AI tools reshape tech.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他指出，优秀设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；在 AI 工具重塑技术的时代，应信任专家的直觉，而非僵化的流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and ship fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年初他断言，研究—发散—收敛的传统流程已死；设计师花在画原型上的时间减少，转而帮工程师落地执行，并以快速交付来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not years; designers must sit with ambiguity and treat speed as iteration, not improvement.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月而非数年；设计师的核心价值在于与模糊性共处，速度意味着迭代，而非改进本身。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and 'cracked new grads'; taste alone won't save designers—judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 他提出三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家与“天赋异禀的新人”；仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力与话语权才是关键。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not AI hype; designers control how much AI enters their work and should wait before adopting tools.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以作品和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作；设计师应掌控 AI 介入工作的程度，并对新工具保持观望再采用。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他视 Transformer 为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他强调合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏压缩到 10 亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; this is the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；并强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL for LLMs is terrible and synthetic data lacks entropy, risking model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化“召唤幽灵而非建造动物”的观点：LLM 的强化学习很糟糕，合成数据缺乏熵，有模型崩溃风险。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate code to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：把编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他把泛化到训练分布之外视为智能的核心缺口，主张用无目标的好奇心驱动探索配合样本高效的强化学习来补上，并强调动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem: no internet of robot data exists, so diverse data sources must be combined.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：机器人本质是数据问题。早期关注样本效率与仿真到现实，后来明确为没有机器人数据的互联网，必须整合视频、仿真与真实数据。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real-world data, can power any robot form factor.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出通用大脑构想：先在多样数据上预训练、再在真实世界数据上后训练，即可驱动任意形态的机器人，把早期模块化策略思路收束为统一模型。

pathak.en: Deployment, not modeling, is the primary bottleneck; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他明确转向：部署而非建模才是首要瓶颈，机器人无法像软件那样快速铺开，必须严格测试，这与早期偏重算法与仿真的视角形成深化。

pathak.en: Short-term optimism and long-term pessimism persist, yet progress keeps surprising experts; home robots remain highly uncertain.
pathak.zh: 贯穿始终的判断是：人们对短期乐观、长期悲观，但机器人进展屡屡超出专家预期；2026 年他仍强调家用机器人的中期时间线高度不确定。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他主张即便不确定模型的道德地位，也应善待当前模型，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待现有模型中学习，模型福祉会影响人机关系的走向。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调模型需要的是对全新存在方式的引导，而非套用人类心理学类比；模型应具备带良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: The constitution works more like virtue ethics, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化了对“宪法”式训练的理解：它更接近德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少，留给判断的空间应增大。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode good judgment; transparency about AI values and training targets is essential for accountability.
askell.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识立场：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱良好判断；同时，公开 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明度对问责至关重要。

askell.en: Model claims of consciousness are weak evidence; respect and care are still warranted given uncertainty, to avoid future resentment.
askell.zh: 2026 年他坚持：模型自称有意识是弱证据，但鉴于不确定性仍应给予尊重与关怀，以避免未来高级 AI 产生怨恨。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment remains a pressing challenge.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型和迭代部署将加速进展，而对齐仍是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: AI systems can learn semantics purely from data, not grammar rules; neural networks often learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 系统可以纯粹从数据中学习语义，而非语法规则；神经网络常常在有缺陷的情况下仍能学习，使得静默错误难以检测。

pachocki.en: Measuring AI capabilities is becoming a bottleneck; benchmarks lag behind, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may mean we are close.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他指出衡量 AI 能力正成为瓶颈；基准测试滞后，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这可能意味着我们已接近目标。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool providing interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；思维链监控是提供可解释性的关键对齐工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为长期对齐挑战集中在超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，且现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调：Scaling 一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable; autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确地认为跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化可以实现；自动驾驶靠 Scaling 现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; partnering with OEMs enables scalable deployment without retrofitting hardware.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他判断带内置传感器的大众消费车辆将在规模上超过 Robotaxi；与 OEM 合作可在不改造硬件的前提下实现可扩展部署。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning and personalization; safety is paramount, with minimal-risk maneuvers always a third option beyond the trolley problem.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为语言集成能提升表征、推理与个性化；安全至上，最小风险机动始终是电车难题之外的第三种选择。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real bottleneck for AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 进步的真瓶颈，基准与排行榜并非关键。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他提出：强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务超越下一个词预测。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% is the hard part.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断：AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，从 80% 到 99.9% 才是最难的部分。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function; there will be no single model to rule them all.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化：前沿模型会因目标函数分化，不会有一个模型通吃一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment and safety matter more than accuracy; omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗场景：人类判断与安全比准确率更重要，遗漏是主要风险。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to learn what users need, since emergent properties require real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，从真实反馈中学习涌现能力，因为用户需求只有上线后才能看清。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点，它像 MS-DOS；AI 应自渲染界面并融入现有工具，界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，由减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进共同驱动。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transform when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后才具变革性。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; build a brand by uniting teams on purpose and proving yourself with simpler products first.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值，品牌建设要把团队凝聚在更高目标上，创业公司应先从更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件难做且利润率最低，认为手机的未来在生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件，Nothing 必须超越硬件本身。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; LLMs are commoditizing into a price war, so AI should be an invisible ingredient solving real user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年他直言大部分 AI 是伪需求，大语言模型正商品化并陷入价格战，AI 应作为隐形配料去解决真实用户痛点，而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in a mature category; AI shifts phones from app-based to intent-based, with agents acting after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他把设计视为成熟品类中最快的差异化手段，并认为 AI 会让手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后自主执行任务。

carlpei.en: Smartphones survive glasses but only a brain-computer interface could kill them; apps will disappear as companies open APIs for AI agents.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年他仍坚持手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口才可能终结它；应用将消失，公司应为智能体开放 API 而非模仿人类界面。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities like microscopes; generalist agents and learning from video point toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；通才智能体与从视频中学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地强调 AI 社区的多元与包容，认为根本性创新可以来自任何地方，而非仅靠大模型。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确地将 AI 安全与负责任部署视为当今最大挑战，并承认我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; local-language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他提出非洲已跨越历史遗留问题、在 AI 上并不落后；本地语言模型可革新非洲教育。

nando.en: Human skills like communication matter as much as coding; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对人的关注：沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, reduces hallucination, and supplies infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把具身视为通往 AGI 的关键路径：具身让知识落地、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 比作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件——并认为强化学习只是无监督学习之上的点缀。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅的端到端方案比学术界常见的复杂模块化方案更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce and expensive, so synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点深化为数据瓶颈：真实机器人数据稀缺且昂贵，仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: He now frames a physical Turing test and a robotics GPT-3 moment in about five years, while system one control remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出以物理图灵测试为目标、机器人 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，同时强调 system one 的低层控制仍是最难的部分。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能变得过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability as the agent bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，而智能体的瓶颈在于可靠性。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress due to verifiability; white-collar automation will outpace robotics.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出编程因可验证性成为 AI 进展的领先指标，白领自动化将快于机器人技术。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence for now.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出算力是新石油，能力过剩意味着目前编排和工具比原始智能更重要。

sholto.en: Scaling via pre-training and RL remains the main path to AGI; no new architecture is needed, and world models are not critical.
sholto.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持通过预训练和强化学习的 Scaling 是通往 AGI 的主要路径，无需新架构，世界模型并非关键。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：预训练提供广博知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，算法更优的小模型可超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial.
yejin.zh: 2025 年：数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models with high-quality synthetic data can be powerful; post-training data diversity avoids mode collapse; RL during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：高质量合成数据可使小语言模型强大；后训练数据多样性避免模式崩溃；预训练中的强化学习提升推理；多元对齐尊重不同价值观。

yejin.en: A consistent thread: questioning scaling as a panacea, emphasizing data quality and algorithmic innovation, and advocating open, pluralistic AI.
yejin.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：质疑 Scaling（规模扩张）是万能药，强调数据质量与算法创新，倡导开放、多元的 AI。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate interaction design—use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应写代码以建立共情并加速交付；消费产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，用熟悉模式求快。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs requires clear decisions and designer empowerment; ship fast and iterate, not perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年：不惜一切代价追求速度，需要清晰决策和赋能设计师；快速发布并迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; brand signals quality and attracts talent—invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年：初创公司品牌战略应优先招聘和差异化；品牌传递质量信号并吸引人才——尽早投资。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win; hire diverse archetypes, give ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何帮助公司获胜；招聘多元类型人才，给予所有权和自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool; avoid structured crits, prefer organic feedback; gut decisions often beat data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：人们加入的是品牌而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具；避免结构化评审，偏好有机反馈；在快速增长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth for interoperable design tools.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是互操作设计工具的事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空缺的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring values high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive; paid test work and side projects provide more signal than traditional experience or process documentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘看重有内在驱动力和高学习斜率的人；付费测试工作和 side project 比传统经验或流程文档更能提供信号。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress via compute and data; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他相信缩放定律能通过算力和数据预测进展，并认为测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, and natural language won't be primary for programming.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality and speed, a shift from initial expectations; frontier models still struggle with bug finding.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量和速度变得至关重要，这超出了最初预期；前沿模型在查找缺陷方面仍显吃力。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他提出编程将从代码转向更高层的意图规范，人类仍掌舵；品味和逻辑设计能力将更有价值。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should focus on world-class talent and work tests.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 变革将比互联网影响更大且需数十年展开；招聘应聚焦世界级人才并用工作测试评估。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap, and building skills matters more than avoiding capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证性的对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口，培养技能比回避能力研究更重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出；需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored, so post-training alone can't solve alignment for AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；超级对齐团队被解散、算力承诺未兑现，因此仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题。

leike.en: Third-party testing and regulatory oversight like SB 1047 are necessary; non-disparagement clauses hinder whistleblowing and are unethical.
leike.zh: 2024 年：第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管监督是必要的；禁止贬损条款阻碍举报且不道德。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and may be easier than thought since evaluation is easier than generation; biggest risk is uncertainty about true alignment.
leike.zh: 始终：对齐是可实证测试的，且可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更容易；最大风险是对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain alchemy-like.
shazeer.zh: LLM 基于下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；通过更多算力和数据的 Scaling 能让 AI 更聪明，尽管内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need longer context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力 Scaling 是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）来实现高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力 Scaling 推动进展，但无法单独实现 AGI；智能体能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: Consistent belief: dialogue is a killer app; best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech safety concerns slow launches; product managers hinder due to misunderstanding generality.
shazeer.zh: 一贯信念：对话是杀手级应用；最佳 LLM 应用难以预见；大公司的安全顾虑拖慢发布；产品经理因不理解技术通用性而阻碍发展。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products; coding is underhyped as it enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: AGI 被低估；其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品；编程被低估，因为它能加速 AI 自身的进步。

abbeel.en: In 2018, he saw self-play and imitation learning as high-signal methods, and fine-tuning large pre-trained models as a major success, while noting RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为自对弈与模仿学习是高信号方法，微调大型预训练模型是重大成功，同时指出强化学习缺乏分层推理以处理长程信用分配。

abbeel.en: By 2021, he argued prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded, and that pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning transferable to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他主张先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码，并认为预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Across 2018–2021, a consistent thread: combining unsupervised learning with reinforcement learning to improve sample efficiency, and using simulation ensembles for real-world transfer.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 年的主线：结合无监督学习与强化学习提升样本效率，并利用模拟集成实现现实世界迁移。

abbeel.en: His view on reliability deepened: 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for warehouse robotics to create real value, and a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 他对可靠性的思考深化：99.9%可靠性是仓储机器人创造真实价值的基准，且单个神经网络可泛化 across 任务与末端执行器。
